programme.title: 那一夜母親是殺人犯日
programme.desc: 十五年前,稻村家的母親為了三個子女的幸福將來,狠心殺死總是藉酒施暴的一家之主,那一夜,一家人的命運從此被改變,兄妹三人從此走上截然不同的人生次男雄二,事件之後遠赴東京,一心追逐記者夢,卻也只能在雜誌社打工勉強糊口長子大樹從小就因為口吃而不擅與人溝通,目前與妻子分居,爭奪女兒的監護權中妹妹園子因為被貼上殺人犯女兒的標籤,不得不放棄成為美髮師的夢想,而在酒吧打工十五年後,母親刑滿依約回到

programme.title: 黑獄斷腸歌之砌生豬肉粵普
programme.desc: 六十年代的香港,警隊貪污嚴重記者程安,在文章爆警察貪污內幕,得罪了華探張耀祖,祖砌安生豬肉,令安含冤入獄監獄的保安主任常以殘酷手段對付不服從的人安真相寫成專稿,偷運出獄外爆大鑊,安從此成了眾人心目中的大英雄

programme.title: 星月童話粵普
programme.desc: 瞳,廿五歲,溫柔可人一次交通意外奪去了瞳的未婚夫達也,但她相信達也仍然未死,他一定在某處等著她瞳隻身遠赴香港,在這裡她竟遇上了一個與達也長得一模一樣的男子-家寶家寶是個出色的探員,可是他的女朋友抵受不了他的工作狂熱,感到孤獨而自殺,令家寶內疚非常

programme.title: 公主復仇記粵普
programme.desc: 貞(鍾欣桐)原是Ken(吳彥祖)的前度女友,卻在個多月前無故被Ken拋棄及後Ken竟將其裸照放上互聯網公諸同好,令學校辭退貞教職貞欲取回Ken手上照片,蘭(陶紅)為避免步貞後塵,決定

programme.title: 無雙粵普
programme.desc: 偽鈔畫師李問在泰國因製作假鈔,遭人密報被捕入獄香港警方將他引渡回港,當律政司要檢控之際,國寶級畫家阮文前來保釋,雙方達成協議 - 如果李問能夠供出偽鈔集團主腦畫家真正身份,便可轉為污點證人故事開始追溯至1985年的溫哥華,李問跟阮文本是一對情侶畫家,其後阮文的作品受人欣賞且擁有專屬經紀人,然而李問卻因為作品原創性不足,只能靠偷偷製作仿真畫維生有回無意間被阮文戳破,雙方起了爭執,兩人漸行

programme.title: 東方不敗之風雲再起粵普
programme.desc: 東方不敗死後,群雄借東方不敗之名自組勢力,天下大亂,當中竟有昔日愛侶--雪千尋,她痴愛東方不敗以至不能自拔,欲再興日月神教同時,錦衣衛顧長風亦受朝廷委派探尋東方不敗死亡之謎原來叱吒風雲的東方不敗並沒有死去

programme.title: 昨日的美食日
programme.desc: 律師筧史朗和髮型師矢吹賢二是一對同居戀人,對他們來說在餐桌一邊享用美食,一邊分享生活瑣事和想法,是最珍貴的日常在史朗的提議下,兩人一同前往京都為賢二慶祝生日,然而在這趟京都之旅後,兩人內心竟有了沒法對對方坦白的事情 某日史朗加班後,竟在商店街撞見賢二與陌生的年輕帥哥並肩而行!與此同時,他的好友小日向大策因同居戀人井上航突然失去蹤影,而尋求協助 原本平靜和煦的日子,突然起了變化!

programme.title: 我愛扭紋柴粵普
programme.desc: 吳山水(周潤發飾)是新界圍頭村村長,有一個青梅竹馬女友郭飛螢(鄭裕玲飾)郭數年前移民外國,其後回港找吳,然而兩人生活圈子不同,故顯得隔膜重重

programme.title: 猜猜我是誰普
programme.desc: 以社會話題的電話詐騙案為題材,阿海與阿芳經營一個跨越中港泰三地的詐騙集團,集團擁有大量銀行卡及客戶資料,中港兩地遍佈提取現金的網絡,只要設在泰國的總部打出電話,幾萬至幾十萬的詐騙金在數十分鐘內即可滾滾而來為了對付這個龐大的詐騙集團,警方設立了一個反詐騙的專案小組,以電腦科技追蹤詐騙金下落女特警小兔混入遠在泰國的詐騙集團,而警員丁小田與小兔裡應外合,專案組與詐騙集團展開層層緊扣的反詐智鬥,

programme.title: AV粵普
programme.desc: 世傑,阿華,明仔和老鼠還有幾個月就要畢業離開大學了,因此他們踏入了一個將要離校但又未投身社會工作的迷茫期他們的一個中學同學阿樂,竟在臨畢業前因(借拍戲溝女事件)被電影學院勒令退學

programme.title: 追龍番外篇之十億探長粵普
programme.desc: 香港六七十年代,警黑勾結,貪汙橫行,社會怨氣極重這時候,生性善良率直的徐樂,由於家境不好,輟學加入警界,穿上警服成為最普通的警員初出茅廬卻因為破獲壹場搶劫案得罪龍探長舅甥,而遭到排擠貶壓,調職到上水警局處理事故糾紛時,幫助並結識了富家千金白珍妮,白珍妮對徐樂一見鐘情一方是一直陪伴自己的女朋友阿貞,一方是能讓自己擺脫困境的富家千金小姐,面臨著權利與愛情的選擇,徐樂如何扭轉乾坤,步步高升

programme.title: 愛得起粵普
programme.desc: 麗娜(梁詠琪 飾) 終於決定離婚了麗娜幾乎巳經忘記了一年前為甚麼要嫁給曉東(邵兵 飾),甚至想不起自己曾經愛上曉東那些優點

programme.title: 倩女幽魂:人間情普
programme.desc: 書生寧採臣赴京趕考,夜宿蘭若寺,邂逅專門代姥姥迷惑男人吸取精氣的聶小倩為了幫姥姥吸納陽氣,聶小倩一行人佯裝成酒家舞女,依仗姿色魅惑男性主動前來只要對方陷入迷魂陣中,即使是略有修為的江湖俠客也能手到擒來然而當她面對温潤書生寧採臣時,一切卻發生了天翻地覆的變化 聶小倩被寧採臣單純到傻的甘心付出感化,一邊是樹妖姥姥,黑山老妖的威逼利誘,一邊是情緣初起的心動,她陷入兩難抉擇當寧採臣得知聶小

programme.title: 降頭
programme.desc: 狄龍劇中為一準新郎,但卻遇上心術不正的恬妮單戀癡纏,更借助邪術降頭,務求奪取男方歡心。後恬妮裙下之臣羅烈及狄龍未婚妻,亦相繼加入戰團。一場因為愛而生與死的鬥爭,複雜的關係加上正邪大鬥法,將人性為達一己私慾的惡行,表露無遺。至於邪是否不能勝正?且看結局便有分曉。

programme.desc: 話說醫務署發覺聖慕倫醫院的醫療水準及設備大有問題,原來該院院長體弱多病,院務交陳醫生主理;但陳個性主觀,行事不依規章,連手下一班見習醫生亦各具「特性」,時鬧笑話,弄至院務混亂。院長決定聘用資深護士長進行改革

programme.title: 邪鬥邪
programme.desc: 餘腩沉溺賭海,由於欠債累累無力償還,遂答應債主以其妻肉償債項。事件被其妻識破,並決意離餘而去。餘動輕生念頭,可最終自殺未遂。餘遇上一名富家老伯,老伯答應給餘巨額現金,只要餘答應幫他娶得美人歸

programme.title: 逃亡
programme.desc: 顧回自幼於土匪窩中長大,卻不屑土匪頭子杜健強的殘忍狠毒。少女唐麗被杜迫作壓寨夫人,顧將唐救出,終被黑、白兩道追殺。顧終鼓起勇氣參與剿匪行動,贏回一個重新做人的機會。

programme.title: 春暖花開
programme.desc: 故事描述,陳太太有女潔玉及美玉,潔玉已工作,美玉仍求學。適逢陳家有空房出租,少奇來租,一談即合;潔玉三個姊姊,皆與租客結婚,所以潔玉表姊趙靜蘭之母決仿效陳家租房選婿。未幾,一醫科學生欣農來租房,趙母見他是理想快婿,忙出租。原來少奇與欣農是同學,少奇老成寡言,被潔玉、美玉視為怪人,欣農則只顧談戀愛…

programme.title: 劍女幽魂
programme.desc: 劍聖女兒霍小芬受命將早前被盜的鎮國之寶金龍寶劍送回京師,途中卻遭玉面童子爪牙截擊和毒害身亡。小芬為報此仇,藉寶劍靈氣還魂,竭盡全力把金龍寶劍送返京師,更成功將玉面童子消滅。最後她把劍親手送交皇上,升天而去。

programme.title: 鱷魚河
programme.desc: 這個故事洋溢著《羅密歐與茱麗葉》般的悲戀色彩。兩個世代積怨已深的家族,被一條遍佈鱷魚的河流阻隔,誰也不願築橋往來。然而,命運卻讓兩家子女在大學裡邂逅並深深相愛。為了相守,他們不僅必須跨越險惡的河流,更要化解兩個家族間延續多年的仇恨。

programme.title: 目無王法
programme.desc: 何中衡、秦英豪及羅正三個初出茅廬的捕快,秉除暴安良,維護法紀之宗旨,盡力撲滅罪行,縣中賭館妓院,均遭掃蕩。三人因堅拒與貪贓枉法的縣官與捕頭同流合污,而慘被陷害

programme.title: 陸小鳳之決戰前後
programme.desc: 兩大武林劍客葉孤城與西門吹雪將於紫禁城決鬥。陸小鳳忖度二人素末謀面,又無利益衝突,無須決鬥,猜想當中一定事有蹊蹺。於是,他決定和花滿樓前往京城調查清楚,卻發現當中隱藏的陰謀…

programme.title: 少林三十六房
programme.desc: 武打明星劉家輝飾演反清組織成員,並逃難到少林寺求藝。為了報仇雪恨,他矢寺要在「天下武宗」少林學懂上乘的武學。他學成少林寺三十五房功夫後,創立少林寺第三十六房功夫。

programme.title: 茅山殭屍拳
programme.desc: 以「趕屍」為業的陳師父與徒弟受託押運九具殭屍,啟程上路。未料途中兩具竟逃脫。其中一具實際上並非殭屍,而是為躲避敵人追殺而假扮的江湖豪客。更令人意外的是,此人與陳師父同樣身懷絕技,二人皆為深不可測的武林高手!

programme.title: 馬哥波羅
programme.desc: 故事描述東遊至中國的馬哥波羅,聽從元世祖忽必烈忠告,到中國各地考察三年,回京後,適逢忽遭反元志士刺殺,幸得蒙古高手護駕,一死一逃;馬憑死者遺言,判斷餘黨必在揚州;馬被任命為總督,率兵將反元者一網打盡;惟馬抵揚後,有感於漢人抗異族的無比決心,遂將蒙兵來攻之事暗告反元志士

programme.title: 錯點鴛鴦
programme.desc: 任職推銷員的余小寶失戀後,遇上剛剛跟男友分手的富家女金金。二人同病相憐,很快便墜入愛河並閃電結婚,開展甜蜜的生活。可惜,此時金金卻發現自己懷上了前男友的骨肉

programme.title: 風雷魔鏡
programme.desc: 精通魔法的九幽魔女為獨霸武林,展開連場驚心動魄的武林鬥爭,參與其中的有金獅門少掌門溫劍鋒及集賢莊莊主千金白小鳳。本來金獅門「雷鏡」與集賢 莊「風鏡」合攏起來所發出的靈光,可把魔女制服,但魔女施展奸計,導致兩派不和,再設法去金獅門偷「雷鏡」、往集賢莊取「風鏡」…

programme.title: 皇家大賊
programme.desc: 幹探周福祥的好友阿金因誤殺途人而辭職,淪為職業殺手。金所執行的多宗兇殺案中,恰巧由周負責,好友二人面臨生死決鬥

programme.title: 燕娘
programme.desc: 李飛龍要出行送鏢,行前囑咐好友王天彪代照顧自己的鏢局及妻兒,不料,天彪竟先誘姦飛龍之妻子,後殺鏢局眾徒,更伏兵襲擊飛龍一行人等。飛龍死裏逃生,請師侄英傑往保護女兒燕娘

programme.title: 燕娘
programme.desc: 李飛龍要出行送鏢,行前囑咐好友王天彪代照顧自己的鏢局及妻兒,不料,天彪竟先誘姦飛龍之妻子,後殺鏢局眾徒,更伏兵襲擊飛龍一行人等。飛龍死裏逃生,請師侄英傑往保護女兒燕娘

programme.title: 寶蓮燈
programme.desc: 這是一個耳熟能詳之中國民間神話故事,講述書生劉彥昌巧遇落入凡間的聖母三娘,二人一見鍾情,結下一段仙凡姻緣。但因與二郎神結怨,屢遭迫害,二郎神更將聖母壓在華山底下。彥昌與聖母之子沉香長大後,聞悉生母被壓華山,悲憤欲絕,藉神斧之助挫敗二郎神,劈山救母。

programme.title: 唐人街功夫小子
programme.desc: 青年譚東獨自從大陸來港投靠祖父,因與黑社會人物徐豪結怨而遭陷害,迫於無奈偷渡到三藩市。東在唐人街飯店覓得工作,後來又因打抱不平而再牽涉入黑幫恩怨中。東更重遇徐豪,二人展開連場惡戰。

programme.title: 女校春色
programme.desc: 化學教師陳子風在一間保守的女校任教,與青梅竹馬的李海倫共事。陳在醫務所拾得棄嬰,後把棄嬰帶到學校照顧,卻被學生謠傳嬰孩乃陳與李之私生子。陳不但輕鬆面對,還將朝氣帶入校園,大受學生歡迎,李亦漸漸愛上陳。但保守派對陳之作風不滿,侍機剷除陳。

programme.title: 影子神鞭
programme.desc: 三十萬鏢銀被持神鞭作武器的劫鏢者劫去。因神鞭是有「影子神鞭」之稱的武林大師方承天的招牌武器,所以他的嫌疑最大,也因此引來連番追捕。自此以後,方消聲匿跡。十五年後,年輕女子楊寒雲突然出現,更拿著與當年一樣的神鞭。究竟這位女子是誰?「影子神鞭」的下落又如何?

programme.title: 菁菁
programme.desc: 故事講述茶居老闆女菁菁與伐木工羅貴生相戀,菁父聞說惡霸看中菁,忙找生籌備婚事;不料翌日生即奉命運送木材進城,只得與菁暫別。生進城後,鎮上即有謠言,說生已在城裡另訂親事;另一方面菁無意中發現惡霸向寡婦施暴,寡婦不甘受辱自殺,惡霸欲殺人滅口,菁身陷險境。

programme.title: 鐵羅漢
programme.desc: 追風刀劉鵬為采花大盜小天尊所殺,遺言徒弟盧漢去京師尋護龍刀復仇。途上,盧助康氏姊妹玉笙與玉簫退敵;抵京後又路見不平,救韓五嫂一命,因而結識韓的女兒牡丹

programme.title: 三笑
programme.desc: 風流才子唐伯虎邂逅了丫鬟秋香,被她所吸引,遂決定隱瞞身份,進入華家作書僮,藉此接近秋香,並向她表明自己的身份和來意,可惜秋香並不相信。最後,唐伯虎憑藉其出眾的個人才智及好友的協助下,終於抱得美人歸。

programme.title: 鷹王
programme.desc: 某天,名震江湖的鷹王遇見重傷的天一堂六舵主,他臨終前告訴鷹王天一堂堂主已被大舵主洪擎天所害,鷹王雖不願多管閑事,但還是遭到洪摯天及其手下顏冰兒的追殺。其後,鷹王出手拯救被監車壓住的女孩,遭到暗算,幸得天一堂七舵主顏玉蓮相救,兩人結為朋友。鷹王告知顏玉蓮六舵主的遺言,並指出其胞妹冰兒不是善類…

programme.title: 江山美人
programme.desc: 正德皇帝江南遇李鳳,兩人互生情愫。臨別前正德聲言回京後會立即迎娶李鳳。一年後,當他派人接李鳳回宮時,她已病重,無法承受長途跋涉。雖然最終及時趕到,卻在心愛之人的懷裡離世……

programme.title: 五毒
programme.desc: 蜈蚣功的鹿峰、蛇功的韋白、蠍子功的孫建、壁虎功的郭追、蛤蟆功的羅莽,各擅勝場,不同型格。電影風格奇特,一開始五毒門清理門戶,派出楊得將五個高手就地正法。同出師門,卻受師父追殺,有人說是喻他一手建立的張家班命运,張徹拍出殺戮的悲劇,沒有他慣常的大義浩然,卻有天地不容的毀滅性。

programme.title: 白蛇傳
programme.desc: 妖精白素貞跟妹妹青青在凡間巧遇前世救命恩人書生許仙,後更以身相許給許仙。後和尚法海揭穿其身份並把這對苦命鴛鴦拆散

programme.title: 成記茶樓
programme.desc: 大哥成從大陸逃到香港,在屋邨經營茶樓,本想安分守己,卻屢遭惡勢力挑釁,而警方卻袖手旁觀,迫使大哥成和茶樓的朋友們決定以牙還牙!

programme.title: 一樂也
programme.desc: 由三個民初故事串聯而成的喜劇小品,許冠文一人分飾多角,其中包括剃頭學徒:有一街坊中風而死,許代師傅守靈,為打發時間與眾人在靈堂玩起「麻雀耍樂」,怎料屍體突然觸電翻生!

programme.title: 至尊一劍
programme.desc: 魔山派秦五新劍術高超,連敗九十九名劍手,終在最後一擊敗在劍神手上。五新知其欠缺一柄寶劍,遂殺死著名鑄劍師老鷹,奪取稀世的「老鷹寶劍」。老鷹之子燕北悲痛萬分,矢誓報仇,不自量力挑戰五新,結果被打落懸崖之下

programme.title: 雇來的爸爸
programme.desc: 小東從小和外婆一起生活,外婆的希望是在去世前為小東找到爸爸。心疼外婆的小東雇傭馬路假冒自己的爸爸以討外婆歡心,不明真相的外婆將遺產留給了馬路,這對冒牌父子在生活中鬧出很多笑話。

programme.title: 楊家溝的天
programme.desc: 講述了法制雜誌社編輯武小悠的姥姥、姥爺通過多種方法不斷溝通協調,化解武小悠和做主編的媽媽之間矛盾的故事。

programme.title: 刑警張玉貴之四忠孝兩全
programme.desc: 玉貴躺在醫院急救手術臺上的時候,女兒團團和妻子付明明正心急火燎地往醫院趕。看著手術臺被一群醫生圍著緊張搶救的爸爸,女兒團團擔心得失聲痛苦,妻子付明明更是悲痛萬分,淚流不止。在隨後趕來的公安局長的安慰下,付明明激動的心情算是稍稍穩定下來。但看

programme.title: 史前超人
programme.desc: 講述西元一萬五千年前,高度文明的亞特蘭蒂斯大陸被一場大海嘯掀入海底,隨後新的生命和文明再次在地球誕生。明朝末年,鄭成功的副將唐文瀾在大海中拾獲裝有亞特蘭蒂斯王子的命運女神之匣,並將嬰兒收養為義子,取名唐律。唐律生來便具有亞特蘭蒂斯人的超能力

programme.title: 跨國大追捕:陽光下的罪惡
programme.desc: 刑偵故事,歌頌公安幹警n退伍特種兵何沖的女友柳小雲被孫剛逼死,何沖決意報復。孫剛逃到俄羅斯,何沖尾隨。雷霄和舒雅等人為查明柳小雲死因真相,亦跟隨來到俄羅斯。何沖最終復仇,殺死孫剛。就在何衝殺死孫剛時,俄員警也將何沖擊斃。

programme.title: 末路狂花錢
programme.desc: 該片講述了人到中年,一事無成的主人公賈有為,被診斷出腦部腫瘤,只剩十天壽命,於是他賣掉了傳言要拆遷的老屋,找回了當年家屬院的發小兄弟,決定在生命最後的十天裡放肆享受,並由此引發了一連串令人捧腹的故事。

programme.title: 八面修羅之鳳凰雪
programme.desc: 一戰後,為逼迫北洋政府簽署不平等條約,日本黑龍會派人假扮獵盟會悍將蕭乾,搶奪毒藥“鳳凰雪,準備在邊城釋放,以百姓生命威脅政府。真蕭乾為自證清白,一起與獵盟會粉碎日本人的陰謀,守護了國家安全

programme.title: 我為豬狂
programme.desc: 一個男人與豬的奇緣 ,一段令人啼笑皆非卻溫馨至腹的故事。n隨著改革開放的逐步深入,大批湧入城市打工的農民工們經過多年在外艱辛的打拼,有的成家立業,有的已經深深的融入了城市的生活。隨著近年來城鄉差距的日益縮小,在外多年的遊子們紛紛萌發了回鄉

programme.title: 人怕出名豬怕壯
programme.desc: 老農沈一金搬入安置房之後各種不習慣。瞞著兒子養了頭豬崽走失,被社區服務站撿到。看豬在社區好吃好喝,愛佔便宜的沈一金索性不去領取。過年社區將豬殺了之後,沈一金上門討要,由此引發了一系列啼笑皆非的故事。

programme.title: 老三追債記
programme.desc: 本片講述了賣狗商人老三一心想擁有一台嶄新的摩托車,但是苦於沒有錢。一個偶然的機會,老三得知張洪曾向媽媽借了三萬元並立下借條。在得到媽媽給的借條後,老三為了自己的摩托車走上了一波三折的討債之旅。為此,老三還上演了一出“炸藥包討債橋段,並因涉

programme.title: 英雄兒女
programme.desc: 根據巴金的小說“團圓改編通過我志願軍某高級指揮員在抗美援朝戰爭中與十八年前失散的女兒重逢的故事,表現了老一代如何在戰鬥中培養新的一代並歌頌中朝人民的戰鬥友誼和偉大的國際主義精神。

programme.title: 老師·好
programme.desc: 1985年的南宿一中,苗宛秋(於謙 飾)老師推自行車昂首走在校園,接受著人們豔羨的目光和紛至遝來的恭維。 桀傲不馴的洛小乙(王廣源 飾)、溫婉可人的安靜(湯夢佳 飾)、新潮前衛的關婷婷(秦鳴悅 飾)、大智若愚的腦袋、舞癡兄弟文明(郝鵬飛 飾

programme.title: 沒有字的信
programme.desc: 描寫一個兒童在老一輩革命者鬥爭事蹟的教育下,思想轉變的故事。

programme.title: 夏都故事

programme.title: 城市野生拯救隊 #5
programme.desc: 這部12集的紀錄片系列將顯示哪些動物居住在城市中,以及牠們遇到了甚麼麻煩當牠們需要幫助時,一隊拯救隊將會出動每年有成千上萬的動物獲得新生,只因志願者和專業人士一同為熱愛的大自然出力

programme.title: 袋熊異聞錄 #2
programme.desc: 袋熊通常是獨居和行動緩慢的動物,但袋熊繁殖時卻變了樣,有著十足精力,侵略性和大量遊玩時間

programme.title: 動物王國 #4
programme.desc: 不速之客以量取勝,獲取領地,有些動物群被列為「害蟲」,但牠們若要生存,就是要找到不歡迎牠們的安身之所

programme.title: 澳洲野鳥 #1
programme.desc: 欣賞一對小企鵝哈利和莎莉的故事這些不會飛,拍翼的鳥類創造了一些大自然中最嘈雜的社區牠們是一個充滿忠誠關係,致力於維繫家庭和充滿活力夜生活的傳奇家族

programme.title: 澳洲野鳥 #2
programme.desc: 鴯鶓是澳洲最大的本土鳥類,也是僅次於非洲鴕鳥的世界第二大鳥類:高2米,步幅近3米,完全不能飛翔牠生活在一個亂七八糟的世界中,由雌鳥主導,有著綠色的蛋,而人類則傾盡全力繁殖和撫養雛鳥,牠們被稱為史皮

programme.title: 澳洲野鳥 #3
programme.desc: 澳洲的猛禽是該處最兇猛的捕食者之一這些高度專業的殺手強大,足智多謀並十分觸目牠們靠著一些令人印象深刻的武器而生存這是澳洲空中獵人的故事

programme.title: 澳洲野鳥 #4
programme.desc: 成功的繁殖對任何鳥類的生存來說都重要尤關,我們在本集會介紹四種鳥類,牠們竭力尋找配偶並撫養後代,為下一代提供最佳的生活機會無論牠們生活在那裡,都有著一堆苦差,保護自己的領地免受入侵者侵害,吸引並贏得配偶,又要保護牠們的雛鳥

programme.title: 野性倖存者 #2
programme.desc: 在尚比亞盧安瓜河谷的乾季時節,食物極其稀少,每一種生物都演化出屬於自己的獨特策略,試圖最大限度地利用有限資源不論是以青草為食的草食動物,還是以捕獵為生的掠食者,都展現出一套生存之道──學習牠們如何覓食,同時又如何巧妙避開成為獵物的命運

programme.title: 風之島 #2 英普
programme.desc: 亞洲最大的象群每年都會齊集於米內瑞亞國家公園舉行盛會;而在本年的周年大會上,於這片神聖的地方,小象洛卡誕生了!一起見證他在大象的混戰中學習進食,游泳和使用他的象鼻

programme.title: 風之島 #3 英普
programme.desc: 斯里蘭卡的低地遍布著數千個看似平靜的湖泊,但「湖」不可貌相,湖水中盡是沼澤鱷的天下沼澤鱷生來就是獵人,一起來看看這些頂尖獵食者在炙熱的環境中如何互相競爭

programme.title: 風之島 #4 英普
programme.desc: 位於明尼亞瑞亞國家公園的一座人造湖,養育了亞洲最大的象群跟隨一頭年輕公象,他正在經歷成長的轉折點走訪熱帶雨林,探索棲居於叢林中各種奇異的昆蟲

programme.title: 風之島 #5 英普
programme.desc: 季候風暴席捲斯里蘭卡的熱帶島嶼,帶著旋風的薄霧和水流襲擊了山區的心臟地帶,開展島上森林許多不斷變化的面貌

programme.title: 風之島 #6 英普
programme.desc: 雅拉國家公園是一個鳥類伊甸園,是215種鳥類的家這個天堂為能度過不斷變化氣候的父母提供了許多可能性 在旱季結束和季侯風風暴開始前,每個物種都必須在這裡飼養後代或找到新家

programme.title: 朝暮動物誌 #3 英普
programme.desc: 新西蘭的聖誕節只是夏天裡的一天雖然標誌性的鷸鴕躲避陽光,但海豹,黃眼企鵝和海豚卻享受長時間日照下充裕的額外餵食時間

programme.title: 朝暮動物誌 #5 英普
programme.desc: 熱帶太平洋生活中的一天在小島上,科莫多巨蜥爭奪食物殘渣,而招潮蟹則在海灘上決鬥在海底,蝠鱝於深海滑翔,奇特的行走鯊魚在色彩斑斕的珊瑚礁中巡邏

programme.title: 鯊魚星球 #1
programme.desc: 與鯊魚一起在海中潛行,看他們使用高度敏銳的感官和殺手的本能進行捕獵觀看白頂礁鯊利用其電子傳感器探測心跳來尋找獵物,以及淺海長尾鯊用其鞭狀的尾巴來擊暈獵物

programme.title: 鯊魚星球 #2
programme.desc: 與那些在藍色的虛空中繁衍生息的流浪鯊魚一起領略海洋的廣闊,深邃與黑暗見識穿越大西洋風暴的海域的孤獨藍鯊,以及返回太平洋島嶼繁殖地的數百條雙髻鯊

programme.title: 鯊魚星球 #3
programme.desc: 跟隨一群具有非凡能力的鯊魚,牠們可以在全球最惡劣的環境中繁衍生息觀察在冰冷的北極水域生活,但幾乎失明的格林蘭鯊,以及另外一種能在陸地行走的物種

programme.title: 鯊王爭霸戰
programme.desc: 見證大白鯊群英的終極戰鬥!科學家們嘗試從新西蘭海岸外的100多條大白鯊中,挑選出領頭的鯊王一起為群雄的速度,獵食技能和無比勇氣而喝采

programme.title: 鯊王爭霸戰:爭雄對決
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​目睹一場前所未有,獨特異常的鯊魚競賽,巨白鯊在令人瞠目結舌,驚心動魄的力量比拼中正面交鋒與鯊魚專家萊利•艾略特博士(Riley Elliott)一起冒險,他努力回答這個古老問題:究竟哪一性別才是海中最強者?

programme.title: 逐雨之途 #3 英普
programme.desc: 跟隨阿納斯塔西亞的足跡,牠的象群因為保護兩隻珍貴的小象而兵分兩路,而獵豹庫萊塔則為牠剩下的幼崽奪回領地塵土散去,雨水開始滋潤乾涸的大地,加入野狗菲尼克斯尋找新伴侶的旅程

programme.title: 逐雨之途 #4 英普
programme.desc: 來到幕後,了解那些致力於保育與保護肯尼亞野生動物的創新團隊看看「拯救大象」組織的無線電追蹤項圈系統,監測野狗群的無人機,以及當地的馬賽獵豹追蹤團隊

programme.title: 動物知心友 #5
programme.desc: 一起去看看樹懶艾莎的近況佩德羅把自己的人生奉獻給照顧牠,因為牠在一次墜落意外後癱瘓了了解為什麼狼索爾願意讓牠的人類夥伴史提夫加入自己的族群,接著再看看克莉絲汀和博如何讓浣熊水晶的生活變得更加方便自在

programme.title: 美洲豹日誌 #3
programme.desc: 跟隨科學家團隊在雨季過後重新走入美洲豹領地,進行一次具規模的搜索,以尋找菲琳娜,菲拉和巴達洛,因為他們的追蹤項圈已經丟失迎接一位生物學家加入團隊,在他的協助下,麗茲·戴利為美洲豹重新安裝追蹤項圈,並添置高科技設備以記錄更多數據

programme.title: 美洲豹日誌 #4
programme.desc: 經歷風暴,洪水和停電,莉茲和獸醫霍亞雷斯仍奮力為更多美洲豹戴上項圈,情勢相當緊張一起尋找巴達洛的下落,並嘗試在追蹤標籤掉落之前找到他,以及拜訪一隻團隊渴望研究的新䧳豹

programme.title: 上城水獭 #3 英普
programme.desc: 準備好在濱海灣的鬥毆吧,在安娜和她的海濱家族遠在上游時,游牧人和城裡人家族佔領了她的領地在這個海灣的合法主人突然返回之前,暫時享受一下這個豪華水道中平靜的水瀨生活吧

programme.desc: 來到幕後,了解那些致力於保育與保護肯尼亞野生動物的創新團隊看看「拯救大象」組織的無線電追蹤項圈系統,監測野狗群的無人機,以及當地的馬賽獵豹追蹤團隊

programme.title: 鯊魚星球 #1
programme.desc: 與鯊魚一起在海中潛行,看他們使用高度敏銳的感官和殺手的本能進行捕獵觀看白頂礁鯊利用其電子傳感器探測心跳來尋找獵物,以及淺海長尾鯊用其鞭狀的尾巴來擊暈獵物

programme.title: 美洲豹日誌 #3
programme.desc: 跟隨科學家團隊在雨季過後重新走入美洲豹領地,進行一次具規模的搜索,以尋找菲琳娜,菲拉和巴達洛,因為他們的追蹤項圈已經丟失迎接一位生物學家加入團隊,在他的協助下,麗茲·戴利為美洲豹重新安裝追蹤項圈,並添置高科技設備以記錄更多數據

programme.title: 美洲豹日誌 #4
programme.desc: 經歷風暴,洪水和停電,莉茲和獸醫霍亞雷斯仍奮力為更多美洲豹戴上項圈,情勢相當緊張一起尋找巴達洛的下落,並嘗試在追蹤標籤掉落之前找到他,以及拜訪一隻團隊渴望研究的新䧳豹

programme.title: 城市野生拯救隊 #7
programme.desc: 這部12集的紀錄片系列將顯示哪些動物居住在城市中,以及牠們遇到了甚麼麻煩當牠們需要幫助時,一隊拯救隊將會出動每年有成千上萬的動物獲得新生,只因志願者和專業人士一同為熱愛的大自然出力

programme.title: 動物知心友 #6
programme.desc: 跟水獺奧茲以及他的教練萊絲莉一起學習游泳,接著看看佩特羅內爾如何贏得犀牛孤兒莉莉的信任,牠曾因偷獵者而受到創傷和老鼠科比一起嗅出地雷,並和雙髻鯊蓋婭一起自由潛水

programme.title: 拉丁美生态奥秘 #1
programme.desc: 哥倫比亞海岸附近,新生的座頭鯨吸了牠的第一口氣牠身長16呎,是一個巨人,但未來的挑戰跟牠一樣巨大在進行地球上最長的遷徙之一前,牠必須快點長大

programme.title: 拉丁美生态奥秘 #2
programme.desc: 隨著松鼠猴的繁殖季節臨近,女強人艾巴必須帶領牠的團伙尋找食物,但男領袖撒母耳能奪得芳心嗎?年輕的沙奇拿迷了路,而敵人逐漸緊逼,局勢開始緊張

programme.title: 上城水獭 #4 英普
programme.desc: 歡迎安娜的族群回到海濱灣, 那裡有兩個擅自闖入的水獭家族當米婭嗅到安娜的氣味並將湯尼族群趕得遠遠的時候,牠感受到了壓力然後,當遊牧族群對即將發生的衝突一無所知時,請抓緊時間

programme.title: 野戰攻略 #2 英普
programme.desc: 大象中途之家 (Elephant Transit Home) 來了新成員:一隻生病的小象在自然保護區附近被拋棄,這是人類和大象爭奪空間下的又一個受害者深入了解在普魯圖·費南多博士的領導下,如何以創新的方式努力結束這場衝突

programme.title: 袋熊異聞錄 #2
programme.desc: 袋熊通常是獨居和行動緩慢的動物,但袋熊繁殖時卻變了樣,有著十足精力,侵略性和大量遊玩時間

programme.title: 動物王國 #4
programme.desc: 不速之客以量取勝,獲取領地,有些動物群被列為「害蟲」,但牠們若要生存,就是要找到不歡迎牠們的安身之所

programme.title: 澳洲野鳥 #1
programme.desc: 欣賞一對小企鵝哈利和莎莉的故事這些不會飛,拍翼的鳥類創造了一些大自然中最嘈雜的社區牠們是一個充滿忠誠關係,致力於維繫家庭和充滿活力夜生活的傳奇家族

programme.title: 澳洲野鳥 #2
programme.desc: 鴯鶓是澳洲最大的本土鳥類,也是僅次於非洲鴕鳥的世界第二大鳥類:高2米,步幅近3米,完全不能飛翔牠生活在一個亂七八糟的世界中,由雌鳥主導,有著綠色的蛋,而人類則傾盡全力繁殖和撫養雛鳥,牠們被稱為史皮

programme.title: 澳洲野鳥 #3
programme.desc: 澳洲的猛禽是該處最兇猛的捕食者之一這些高度專業的殺手強大,足智多謀並十分觸目牠們靠著一些令人印象深刻的武器而生存這是澳洲空中獵人的故事

programme.title: 澳洲野鳥 #4
programme.desc: 成功的繁殖對任何鳥類的生存來說都重要尤關,我們在本集會介紹四種鳥類,牠們竭力尋找配偶並撫養後代,為下一代提供最佳的生活機會無論牠們生活在那裡,都有著一堆苦差,保護自己的領地免受入侵者侵害,吸引並贏得配偶,又要保護牠們的雛鳥

programme.title: 野性倖存者 #2
programme.desc: 在尚比亞盧安瓜河谷的乾季時節,食物極其稀少,每一種生物都演化出屬於自己的獨特策略,試圖最大限度地利用有限資源不論是以青草為食的草食動物,還是以捕獵為生的掠食者,都展現出一套生存之道──學習牠們如何覓食,同時又如何巧妙避開成為獵物的命運

programme.title: 風之島 #2 英普
programme.desc: 亞洲最大的象群每年都會齊集於米內瑞亞國家公園舉行盛會;而在本年的周年大會上,於這片神聖的地方,小象洛卡誕生了!一起見證他在大象的混戰中學習進食,游泳和使用他的象鼻

programme.title: 風之島 #3 英普
programme.desc: 斯里蘭卡的低地遍布著數千個看似平靜的湖泊,但「湖」不可貌相,湖水中盡是沼澤鱷的天下沼澤鱷生來就是獵人,一起來看看這些頂尖獵食者在炙熱的環境中如何互相競爭

programme.title: 風之島 #4 英普
programme.desc: 位於明尼亞瑞亞國家公園的一座人造湖,養育了亞洲最大的象群跟隨一頭年輕公象,他正在經歷成長的轉折點走訪熱帶雨林,探索棲居於叢林中各種奇異的昆蟲

programme.title: 風之島 #5 英普
programme.desc: 季候風暴席捲斯里蘭卡的熱帶島嶼,帶著旋風的薄霧和水流襲擊了山區的心臟地帶,開展島上森林許多不斷變化的面貌

programme.title: 風之島 #6 英普
programme.desc: 雅拉國家公園是一個鳥類伊甸園,是215種鳥類的家這個天堂為能度過不斷變化氣候的父母提供了許多可能性 在旱季結束和季侯風風暴開始前,每個物種都必須在這裡飼養後代或找到新家

programme.title: 朝暮動物誌 #3 英普
programme.desc: 新西蘭的聖誕節只是夏天裡的一天雖然標誌性的鷸鴕躲避陽光,但海豹,黃眼企鵝和海豚卻享受長時間日照下充裕的額外餵食時間

programme.title: 朝暮動物誌 #5 英普
programme.desc: 熱帶太平洋生活中的一天在小島上,科莫多巨蜥爭奪食物殘渣,而招潮蟹則在海灘上決鬥在海底,蝠鱝於深海滑翔,奇特的行走鯊魚在色彩斑斕的珊瑚礁中巡邏

programme.title: 鯊魚星球 #1
programme.desc: 與鯊魚一起在海中潛行,看他們使用高度敏銳的感官和殺手的本能進行捕獵觀看白頂礁鯊利用其電子傳感器探測心跳來尋找獵物,以及淺海長尾鯊用其鞭狀的尾巴來擊暈獵物

programme.desc: 與那些在藍色的虛空中繁衍生息的流浪鯊魚一起領略海洋的廣闊,深邃與黑暗見識穿越大西洋風暴的海域的孤獨藍鯊,以及返回太平洋島嶼繁殖地的數百條雙髻鯊

programme.title: 鯊魚星球 #3
programme.desc: 跟隨一群具有非凡能力的鯊魚,牠們可以在全球最惡劣的環境中繁衍生息觀察在冰冷的北極水域生活,但幾乎失明的格林蘭鯊,以及另外一種能在陸地行走的物種

programme.title: 鯊王爭霸戰
programme.desc: 見證大白鯊群英的終極戰鬥!科學家們嘗試從新西蘭海岸外的100多條大白鯊中,挑選出領頭的鯊王一起為群雄的速度,獵食技能和無比勇氣而喝采

programme.title: 鯊王爭霸戰:爭雄對決
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​目睹一場前所未有,獨特異常的鯊魚競賽,巨白鯊在令人瞠目結舌,驚心動魄的力量比拼中正面交鋒與鯊魚專家萊利•艾略特博士(Riley Elliott)一起冒險,他努力回答這個古老問題:究竟哪一性別才是海中最強者?

programme.title: 朝暮動物誌 #3 英普
programme.desc: 新西蘭的聖誕節只是夏天裡的一天雖然標誌性的鷸鴕躲避陽光,但海豹,黃眼企鵝和海豚卻享受長時間日照下充裕的額外餵食時間

programme.title: 朝暮動物誌 #5 英普
programme.desc: 熱帶太平洋生活中的一天在小島上,科莫多巨蜥爭奪食物殘渣,而招潮蟹則在海灘上決鬥在海底,蝠鱝於深海滑翔,奇特的行走鯊魚在色彩斑斕的珊瑚礁中巡邏

programme.title: 鯊魚星球 #1
programme.desc: 與鯊魚一起在海中潛行,看他們使用高度敏銳的感官和殺手的本能進行捕獵觀看白頂礁鯊利用其電子傳感器探測心跳來尋找獵物,以及淺海長尾鯊用其鞭狀的尾巴來擊暈獵物

programme.title: 鯊魚星球 #2
programme.desc: 與那些在藍色的虛空中繁衍生息的流浪鯊魚一起領略海洋的廣闊,深邃與黑暗見識穿越大西洋風暴的海域的孤獨藍鯊,以及返回太平洋島嶼繁殖地的數百條雙髻鯊

programme.title: 鯊魚星球 #3
programme.desc: 跟隨一群具有非凡能力的鯊魚,牠們可以在全球最惡劣的環境中繁衍生息觀察在冰冷的北極水域生活,但幾乎失明的格林蘭鯊,以及另外一種能在陸地行走的物種

programme.title: 鯊王爭霸戰
programme.desc: 見證大白鯊群英的終極戰鬥!科學家們嘗試從新西蘭海岸外的100多條大白鯊中,挑選出領頭的鯊王一起為群雄的速度,獵食技能和無比勇氣而喝采

programme.title: 鯊王爭霸戰:爭雄對決
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​目睹一場前所未有,獨特異常的鯊魚競賽,巨白鯊在令人瞠目結舌,驚心動魄的力量比拼中正面交鋒與鯊魚專家萊利•艾略特博士(Riley Elliott)一起冒險,他努力回答這個古老問題:究竟哪一性別才是海中最強者?

programme.title: 城市野生拯救隊 #6
programme.desc: 這部12集的紀錄片系列將顯示哪些動物居住在城市中,以及牠們遇到了甚麼麻煩當牠們需要幫助時,一隊拯救隊將會出動每年有成千上萬的動物獲得新生,只因志願者和專業人士一同為熱愛的大自然出力

programme.title: 逐雨之途 #3 英普
programme.desc: 跟隨阿納斯塔西亞的足跡,牠的象群因為保護兩隻珍貴的小象而兵分兩路,而獵豹庫萊塔則為牠剩下的幼崽奪回領地塵土散去,雨水開始滋潤乾涸的大地,加入野狗菲尼克斯尋找新伴侶的旅程

programme.title: 逐雨之途 #4 英普
programme.desc: 來到幕後,了解那些致力於保育與保護肯尼亞野生動物的創新團隊看看「拯救大象」組織的無線電追蹤項圈系統,監測野狗群的無人機,以及當地的馬賽獵豹追蹤團隊

programme.title: 動物知心友 #5
programme.desc: 一起去看看樹懶艾莎的近況佩德羅把自己的人生奉獻給照顧牠,因為牠在一次墜落意外後癱瘓了了解為什麼狼索爾願意讓牠的人類夥伴史提夫加入自己的族群,接著再看看克莉絲汀和博如何讓浣熊水晶的生活變得更加方便自在

programme.title: 美洲豹日誌 #3
programme.desc: 跟隨科學家團隊在雨季過後重新走入美洲豹領地,進行一次具規模的搜索,以尋找菲琳娜,菲拉和巴達洛,因為他們的追蹤項圈已經丟失迎接一位生物學家加入團隊,在他的協助下,麗茲·戴利為美洲豹重新安裝追蹤項圈,並添置高科技設備以記錄更多數據

programme.title: 美洲豹日誌 #4
programme.desc: 經歷風暴,洪水和停電,莉茲和獸醫霍亞雷斯仍奮力為更多美洲豹戴上項圈,情勢相當緊張一起尋找巴達洛的下落,並嘗試在追蹤標籤掉落之前找到他,以及拜訪一隻團隊渴望研究的新䧳豹

programme.title: 上城水獭 #3 英普
programme.desc: 準備好在濱海灣的鬥毆吧,在安娜和她的海濱家族遠在上游時,游牧人和城裡人家族佔領了她的領地在這個海灣的合法主人突然返回之前,暫時享受一下這個豪華水道中平靜的水瀨生活吧

programme.title: 野戰攻略 #1 英普
programme.desc: 雅拉國家公園的森林是神祕懶熊的家這種動物生性害羞,很少被看見及拍攝加入野生動物影片製作團隊,跟著他們揭開前所未見的神祕懶熊生活和行為

programme.title: 動物知心友 #6
programme.desc: 跟水獺奧茲以及他的教練萊絲莉一起學習游泳,接著看看佩特羅內爾如何贏得犀牛孤兒莉莉的信任,牠曾因偷獵者而受到創傷和老鼠科比一起嗅出地雷,並和雙髻鯊蓋婭一起自由潛水

programme.title: 拉丁美生态奥秘 #1
programme.desc: 哥倫比亞海岸附近,新生的座頭鯨吸了牠的第一口氣牠身長16呎,是一個巨人,但未來的挑戰跟牠一樣巨大在進行地球上最長的遷徙之一前,牠必須快點長大

programme.title: 拉丁美生态奥秘 #2
programme.desc: 隨著松鼠猴的繁殖季節臨近,女強人艾巴必須帶領牠的團伙尋找食物,但男領袖撒母耳能奪得芳心嗎?年輕的沙奇拿迷了路,而敵人逐漸緊逼,局勢開始緊張

programme.title: 上城水獭 #4 英普
programme.desc: 歡迎安娜的族群回到海濱灣, 那裡有兩個擅自闖入的水獭家族當米婭嗅到安娜的氣味並將湯尼族群趕得遠遠的時候,牠感受到了壓力然後,當遊牧族群對即將發生的衝突一無所知時,請抓緊時間

programme.title: 野戰攻略 #2 英普
programme.desc: 大象中途之家 (Elephant Transit Home) 來了新成員:一隻生病的小象在自然保護區附近被拋棄,這是人類和大象爭奪空間下的又一個受害者深入了解在普魯圖·費南多博士的領導下,如何以創新的方式努力結束這場衝突

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #3

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #4

programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球深度行IV 鐵証待判
programme.desc: 《地球深度行4之鐵證待判》繼續以遊歷的方式,走進荷蘭、土耳其、約旦、敍利亞,涉及接近50個地點,超過30個已經發生嘅神蹟預言、傳奇故事,以考古和實證,重新解構連科學都不能解釋的千古謎團。 歷年來有無數的考古學家和世界知名的紀錄片頻道,為瞭解開上帝藉著摩西施行神蹟分割紅海這個歷史迷團,他們都不惜花上大

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國、英國、 瑞士、澳洲、土耳其、以色列、埃及、中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。n一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 眾人來到位於廣州黃埔區的「波羅廟」，還找到名副其實的「波羅雞」，而要做出這款精緻手作，果然是「一味靠黐」！開平鎮濠村的「鎮濠泥雞」同樣名氣十足，四位主持一邊「吹雞」，一邊暢談與雞相關的粵語。精通中文的廖Sir與熟識潮語的麥美恩在「醫館」會診，為騎呢街坊解答「富貴於我如浮雲」、「生骨大頭菜」等講法的來源。志堅反串「剩女」，與「長腿」祖儀爭奪男神芳心，最終誰會淪為被嫌棄的「賣剩蔗」，繼續「攝灶罅」？

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 昔日通勝內容上至天文地理下至英語教學，文軒飾演的騙徒被揭破奸計，皆因他「一本通書睇到老」？智堅在江門市展館拾起名物茅龍筆時遇見「幽靈」，幸得蕭博士道出茅龍筆起源，解開其心結。火水哥情迷體育健將何泳芍，運動場上全力「狗衝」，期間還有體育專家雷雄德替他解構「揼釘」、「炒芥蘭」等體育術語，追求大計能否成功？導遊帶團友品嚐「大馬站煲」卻錯摸門牌，還推說「大馬站過小馬站－ 相差不遠」，廖Sir細述相關謬誤。

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 今回上演「是非精」大內訌，由梁嘉琪、張秀文組成「師姐隊」火併馮盈盈、張寶兒的「師妹隊」。法國人會將各式石頭應用於日常生活，當地商店一款神秘結晶石塊，究竟有何用途？台灣農莊一間看似平平無奇的房子，原來在建造時採用了一種環保物料；兩隊同時使用錦囊，得以近距離探究一番，能否猜出「用乜料」？韓國人有一種奇趣習慣，喜歡於下雨天吃煎餅，原因何在？兩隊及後分別將所得分數兌換成不同貨幣，竟換來天壤之別的結局！

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 農夫設計「絕核」對白介紹嘉賓袁文傑和高海寧，結果令Do姐忍俊不禁，有多惹笑？首爾麻浦區的綜合文化公園內，有大型建築物由廢料改建而成，兩位嘉賓可有頭緒？「泰國通」胡慧冲帶大家置身曼谷一個放着巨型飛機擺設的市集，還找來藍白色小袋子，後者原來有特別用途？鏡頭轉往台灣的鹿港，當地有夾公仔機所夾的已非公仔，更深受女士們歡迎！積分兌換貨幣環節，有人不幸打破金額新低紀錄，是哪個地區的貨幣令嘉賓「中伏」？

programme.title: 文明啟航粵英
programme.desc: 一連六集，歷史學家Bettany Hughes將帶領觀眾踏上另一段令人難忘的人類文明史之旅。

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: Ring Marry回國的目的，是為小鈴的二哥優介舉行一個秘密婚禮，未來等人知情後，也協助準備婚禮，還為過程進行直播。但是，吉祥物菈比莉卻一直悶悶不樂，擔心婚禮過後，就要跟Ring Marry各分異地。

programme.title: 喜羊羊與灰太狼之羊羊趣冒險粵普
programme.desc: 未來的小羊們獲得了灰太狼新制的發明“變小手錶”，變成迷你版小羊並坐上慢羊羊發明的玩具小車，前往微觀世界，幫助大家解決各式各樣的問題。

programme.title: 喜羊羊與灰太狼之羊羊趣冒險粵普
programme.desc: 未來的小羊們獲得了灰太狼新制的發明“變小手錶”，變成迷你版小羊並坐上慢羊羊發明的玩具小車，前往微觀世界，幫助大家解決各式各樣的問題。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 多啦A夢買了新法寶「剝皮指套」，卻因為自己無法戴上而憤憤不平，大雄趁機借來自己玩個飽。多啦A夢用「預知未來的相機」調查哪個豆沙包先變壞，大雄把買菜的工作推給多啦A夢，自己跑去四處拍照。

programme.title: 少女煮意日常粵日
programme.desc: 大除夕，飲食文化研究會的成員在學會室大掃除。打掃途中，真子想起剛加入學會時的種種往事。來到夜晚，大家一起品嚐過年菜式，還一起到神社參拜，祈求新的一年，大家能夠創造更多美好的回憶。

programme.title: 一路繁花粵
programme.desc: 女主持置身號稱上海最美的圖書館，拍下滿滿打卡美照。子羚先細味藏族特色咖啡，再於泳池旁會合靖峰歎西式早午餐。走進以內地校園為主題的餐廳，子羚戴上眼鏡化身老師，帶靖峰「闖入」男生宿舍用膳，盛菜的器皿亦甚具年代感。子羚、蓓蔚兩位超齡兒童，嘗試製作昆蟲標本，成品怎樣？壓軸到訪劇集《繁花》取景的古董咖啡店，三人細談這趟上海之旅的感受。此外，麥長青在港拜訪《繁花》主演們的髮型設計師，了解其創作劇中髮型的靈感

programme.title: 煮戰粵
programme.desc: 精緻又美味的吞嚥餐，能讓有需要人士重拾進食的樂趣。面對強敵Ken的豪華「法宴」，Ricky竟出奇招以平實菜單應戰……Ken用廣島蠔製作軟餐，先要去除裙邊與帶子；嘉賓安德尊對此做法存疑，反被美儀質疑？芝士釀松葉蟹鉗還原食物的原貌，以「寶盒」上菜更令人眼前一亮！Ricky開口得罪美儀，令保哥慘變夾心人！雖然午餐肉有違吞嚥餐的「有營」宗旨，但與豆腐配搭得宜。「全球最好飲的粟米湯」為評判們帶來怎樣的感覺？

programme.title: 煮戰粵
programme.desc: 中廚Alan與西廚Ken上演終極煮戰，爭奪金獎寶座！前者得工作夥伴及參賽隊友力撐，士氣高昂；後者獲美國星級名廚拍片支持，還有家人現場打氣，信心大增！首回合，兩強於限時九十秒內煮出雞蛋新滋味，勝方即可獲十分。Alan以「香蔥滑芙蓉」展現對火候的掌控；Ken則用「醉蛋燒」突顯味道的融合，誰人能夠擊中評判蔣怡、幟哥和Jacky的口味，先拔頭籌？第二回合緊接展開，兩人恰巧地要藉海鮮料理，向兩位隊長致敬……

programme.title: 積金講e啲粵
programme.desc: 強積金是僱員退休後的保障之一，跟全港打工仔女息息相關。《積金講e啲》由藝員梁敏巧、吳幸美、曾展望、徐榮、鄧凱文、曾錦燊、吳香倫參與演出，以輕鬆手法向強積金計劃的持分者，介紹當局網上平台「積金易」等與強積金相關的實用資訊及注意事項。

programme.title: 初入職場·中醫季粵普
programme.desc: 《初入職場·中醫季》深度聚焦中醫文化，攜手中醫專業人才及中醫助力團一起，通過"潮養生活"與"中醫歷練"，開啟一場年輕態的中醫文化科普之旅。

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 試做曲奇餅可算是甜品初哥的入門必修課，陳敏之於去年開設自家餅店，稱得上曲奇餅專家。難得餅店「老闆」大駕光臨，阿古(古嘉俊)當然落足心思，透過別出心裁的創意配搭為敏之帶來驚喜。甜美的朱古力與幼滑的慕絲原是天作之合，「古靈精怪」的阿古偏偏要將紫菜加入其中，製成「紫菜牛奶朱古力慕絲球」，破格口味固然叫敏之嘆為觀止，今次難忘體驗又會否啟發她做出新口味曲奇？

programme.title: 香港原味道粵
programme.desc: 譚玉瑛第四次領軍，帶着黃庭鋒、吳幸美、孔德賢、林正峰，還有新主持謝東閔及來自台灣的劉子碩，深入土炮食材的產地，尋找來自本港或香港製造的優質食材；亦體驗網購、外送美食新潮流。深入本地菜園、魚排、鮮果園、養雞場、茶園、食品廠、醬油廠等等，見證本地農業、漁業的發展，認識地道食材，發掘更多本地飲食智慧，品嚐每一口新鮮美味，探索每一種港產食材背後的故事。新環節「種出原味道」由庭鋒打理農田，親手種有機菜！

programme.title: OSIM (TVB 特約合作伙伴) 呈獻:2026英雄聯盟季中邀請賽直播粵普
programme.desc: 《2026英雄聯盟季中邀請賽》在韓國大田點燃戰火，來自六大戰區的「英雄聯盟」頂尖戰隊集結，於賽季中段正面交鋒，爭奪全球總決賽的參賽資格，同時為所在賽區拿取額外席位。主持戴祖儀、張與辰、施焯日、電競賽事評述員老星、彭泳熙Heibi、嘉賓麥玲玲，引領電競迷於TVB翡翠台、明珠台，同步收看季中冠軍賽盛況。兩強爭霸，BO5戰局決高下！

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
星期日檔案粵
programme.desc: 本港以至全球溫度屢創新高，很多人以為戶外烈日當空要小心，但其實在室內都有機會中暑，翳焗天氣、持續熱夜，對身體的威脅比日間可能更大。天氣無法逆轉，我們又可以如何應對呢？

programme.title: 積金講e啲粵
programme.desc: 強積金是僱員退休後的保障之一，跟全港打工仔女息息相關。《積金講e啲》由藝員梁敏巧、吳幸美、曾展望、徐榮、鄧凱文、曾錦燊、吳香倫參與演出，以輕鬆手法向強積金計劃的持分者，介紹當局網上平台「積金易」等與強積金相關的實用資訊及注意事項。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 有小朋友參與汽球主題活動，到波波池遊玩時遭弄傷，家長網上出帖換來不少「共鳴」，主辦單位有何跟進措施？有市民北上光顧按摩服務，期間有人向其推銷，強調免費體驗最後卻索價數萬元。事主聲稱對方強迫其用指模及人面識別以「打開錢包」，其後使用套票又再度被強行推銷？鄭秀文答謝會第二場，許志安驚喜現身，二人甜蜜放閃。《中年好聲音4》最新一集請來梁漢文任評審，劉浩龍與「高成彬」劉倬昕亦到現場聽歌，今集送上幕後花絮。

programme.title: 保濟丸130 週年呈獻：中年好聲音4粵
programme.desc: 《中年好聲音4》的終極十強，會於本集比拼結束後誕生，十一位參賽者要以經典失戀歌分勝負。在這重要時刻，演繹失戀情歌甚有經驗的梁漢文應邀擔任「嘉賓評審」，還提到初入行時，經理人就鼓勵他談戀愛，借此吸收失戀經驗！此外，另一位星級歌手劉浩龍，以及「高成彬」劉倬昕前來聽歌兼出任「知音人」，倬昕更「點名」有關注某位男選手。

programme.title: 一周星星粵
programme.desc: 葉麗儀、陳潔靈自言合作過數百次，真正熟絡，卻是接近千禧年代的事？兩人參加同一比賽入行，但大眾記憶或因「曼德拉效應」而誤會了排名？本尊親口拆解！她們曾和肥媽以「三個女人一個墟」之名開騷，舞台演出開心相處之外，也共同承擔一些人生悲痛事！葉麗儀被讚英文好，原來與中學第一張成績表差勁有關。陳潔靈首次聽到林子祥評價她，更自揭差點成為其弟婦？兩人將再合作舉行演唱會，提到堅持歌唱，背後別具一個正面意義？

programme.title: 美食新聞周報粵
programme.desc: 酒店糕餅總廚楊焯賢推薦獲米芝蓮推介的潮州餐廳，品嚐滷水鵝片鵝肝及手工菜荷包鱔，別具風味。的士司機華哥則推介大圍燒烤店，串燒煙肉荔枝、半熟醬漬三文魚及劍魚腩，皆是必吃之選。施焯日與陳若思繼續發掘謝霆鋒愛店，試吃泰式和牛濃湯粉、炸豬頸肉配烤番茄醬，非常惹味。行仔、波波品嚐全港唯一獲國際認證的正宗拿坡里薄餅，包括蛋撻炸薄餅、瑪格麗特炸薄餅，以及本地限定口味麻辣鹹牛肉薄餅，並略說製作拿坡里薄餅的標準。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
廉政狙擊#14粵PG
programme.desc: 屠敏的下屬捷足先登找到針對卓廷光的傳媒記者，並及時阻止消息外流，保住了卓廷光的名聲。卓以凡相約屠敏道謝，漸漸對她放下戒心，還聊到兒時回憶。黎曉山和洛子峰前往遠勝工業大廈探望生病的馨姐，突然遇上火警…

programme.desc: 《初入職場·中醫季》深度聚焦中醫文化，攜手中醫專業人才及中醫助力團一起，通過"潮養生活"與"中醫歷練"，開啟一場年輕態的中醫文化科普之旅。

programme.title: 雙祥見粵
programme.desc: 身為海豐人的黎耀祥準備了家鄉特色小菜-菜茶，而中山人的阮兆祥則用氣炸鍋煮中山名菜-石岐紅燒乳鴿，二人頓時家鄉回憶湧現，大談衣錦還鄉的經歷。藝人拍攝愛情片，跟不同對手演繹過無數愛情故事…

programme.desc: 中廚Alan與西廚Ken上演終極煮戰，爭奪金獎寶座！前者得工作夥伴及參賽隊友力撐，士氣高昂；後者獲美國星級名廚拍片支持，還有家人現場打氣，信心大增！首回合，兩強於限時九十秒內煮出雞蛋新滋味，勝方即可獲十分。Alan以「香蔥滑芙蓉」展現對火候的掌控；Ken則用「醉蛋燒」突顯味道的融合，誰人能夠擊中評判蔣怡、幟哥和Jacky的口味，先拔頭籌？第二回合緊接展開，兩人恰巧地要藉海鮮料理，向兩位隊長致敬……

programme.title: 文明啟航粵英
programme.desc: 一連六集，歷史學家Bettany Hughes將帶領觀眾踏上另一段令人難忘的人類文明史之旅。

programme.desc: 肥媽發掘豬的內在美。原來白醋和腐皮對胡椒豬肚湯有畫龍點睛的作用。以西式食材炮製燜豬脷，有何驚喜？四十多元買豬膶，就煮到接近十人份量的豬膶麵，符合食平D精神。煮西米是椰汁椰糖西米糕的關鍵，怎樣煮才合格？

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 熬夜會導致「爆血管」？腦科醫生指長期熬夜令血壓難以下降，增加中風與腦血管疾病的風險。醫生提醒如出現突發的嚴重頭痛，要盡快求醫。她亦帶來熬夜後的補救方法，以及預防中風的建議。蓋鳴暉將與內地名伶李淑勤合演粵劇戲寶《帝女花》，兩位大老倌合作於一杯咖啡的時間內促成？她細談籌備點滴，並回顧近四十年的舞台生涯。她自揭本想當花旦，為求入行才任文武生。「睇餸食飯」環節，陳國賓示範「涼拌牛油果煎小青椒」，清爽開胃。

programme.title: 大灣區美味好玩攻略粵
programme.desc: 郭柏姸再次前來跟美儀、麥包吃喝玩樂，還帶上好姊妹羅毓儀一同遊開平。馬降龍碉樓、赤坎古鎮皆充滿古舊氣息，吸引大家瘋狂打卡。古鎮內的特色酒店設計雅致，感覺舒適。古鎮入夜後還會舉行不少表演，配合光影效果，讓人目不暇給。享用全鵝宴，把鵝蛋先蒸後炸的菜式，口感有驚喜。遊覽由舊村落活化而成的文化區，行逛糧倉改建的書店，下榻民宿，並品嚐以柴火烹調的美食。台山的黃鱔飯遠近馳名，再用鱔骨煮湯，大家吃得甚是滿足。

programme.title: 東坡家事#1粵PG
programme.desc: 蘇東坡帶堂姨仔王閏之到潤州找尋美食，認識韓元。閏之暗示要嫁東坡，東坡因思念亡妻不敢有非份之想。蘇小妹誤闖擂台被予婚書，小妹堅拒不嫁。壽安郡主為報復藉柳月娥之口逼閏之嫁韓元；閏之為保東坡，答允嫁韓元……

programme.title: 科學×冒險 絕境求生手冊粵日
programme.desc: 戴雅三人被被雨水沖進葫蘆池，就在她們爬上荷葉，暫得一時安穩之際，無數的水蚊竟重重包圍著她們。水蚊是吸食生物體液的肉食昆蟲，戴雅一行將如何脫險？與此同時，歌博士終於發現三人久未歸家，慌張地開始搜索……

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 太陽系內包羅萬有，除了大家熟悉的恆星、行星和衛星外，還有較袖珍的「小行星」。「Kids’ Notes」，嘉賓會講解何謂小行星，並展示一款相關模型。為何九成的小行星都位於火星和木星之間？任何發現新小行星的人都有權為其命名，但要符合甚麼條件？嘉賓還提及命名上與香港有密切關係的幾顆小行星。以前會說「九大行星」，但冥王星自2006年起，被降級至矮行星，嘉賓細談矮行星的特徵，並帶來更多有關冥王星的數據資訊。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 大家一起去賞花，多啦美看到至愛的蜜瓜包卻悶悶不樂，大家於是決定為她炮製最美味的蜜瓜包。胖虎等人踢足球踢到大雄卻堅拒道歉，多啦A夢於是拿出「道歉蝗蟲」，被附身的人會反省過錯，深切道歉。

programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2849粵 及 保誠精選「寵愛寶」呈獻：社畜求生101粵
programme.desc: 敢威發現天娥搬到璟風住所居住，暗中關注她，對其態度本已軟化。天娥卻以Coupon女皇身分公開出席商界聚會，更刻意與敢威撇清關係，引起外界揣測，令敢威不悅。另一方面，因瑞素之故，敢威對璟風本已有所不滿，加上璟風跟天娥關係要好，父子矛盾亦再加深。力蓮伺機出擊，徵得敢威同意空降尋寶圖，與璟風對着幹……其後，璟風為維護瑞素再與敢威爭執，兩人不歡而散。雷公碰巧目睹，並向璟風提議……

programme.title: 森下仁丹Bifina Si 益生菌呈獻：非份之罪#11粵PG
programme.desc: 淑嫻承認於紹聰死的當晚到過村屋，但沒有殺害他……淑嫻質問宏智為何要將證物放到其房間，宏智支吾以對，使淑嫻懷疑始作俑者是悅萍……淑嫻獨自到塔東島懷緬紹聰，帶弟擔心其安危趕到塔東島尋找，慶幸在入黑前找到淑嫻。悅萍帶宏智搬離張家，淑嫻質問其用意，悅萍卻當眾誣陷淑嫻用錢收買，目的是不讓紹聰葬在張家墓地，令淑嫻受盡千夫所指。紹聰設靈當日，警方告知眾人，根據智能手錶公司記錄，得出紹聰最後心跳時間……

programme.title: 食玩假期呈獻：江湖見粵
programme.desc: 師兄弟轉赴河南開封，沿黃河開展遊歷之旅。第一站走進開封府，尋訪當地最具代表性的歷史名人包拯足跡。府內的題名記碑刻有歷任開封府尹姓名，竟「獨缺」包拯？黎耀祥擊鼓，麥包「客串」包大人升堂，帶出原來黑面包公、堂上開鍘行刑的情節只是劇集改編。鐵塔是北宋保留至今的歷史建築，步近一看，塔身竟呈傾斜狀態，原來這是設計者當年刻意為之？旅遊達人再帶主持體驗地道早餐，了解河南人如何用灌雞蛋、胡辣湯等開啟美好的一天。

programme.title: 女法醫解密#21粵普PG
programme.desc: 秦莞聽完瑾妃被殺過程後與燕遲展開調查，竟發現皇上在潛邸時的墨寶與平時硃批不同。燕麒殺死燕徹後，稱其是自殺，皇上命燕遲和秦莞調查真相。皇后暗傳訊息給秦莞，她與燕遲找到一婦人，由此得知太后當年產子的秘密…

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵

獵鷹#19粵PG
programme.desc: 一帆到機場欲離港，但已被劉Sir佈下之天羅地網所擒。劉Sir以調查祥旺之死為名，隨即扣留一帆之證件。大偉聽劉Sir之命調查崔福所在，崔福亦命國基打聽大偉及陳水消息，大偉不知底蘊欲問國基崔福之所在，國基即知大偉乃崔福欲殺的其中一人。一帆命張錦替之找船潛逃他方。戚幹不知大偉行蹤，十分擔心，遂著同袍加以留意。陳水暗持搶械欲殺大偉，豈料戚幹到來，見陳水不懷好意，不顧一切上前撲救，不幸被陳水槍傷。

programme.title: 科學×冒險 絕境求生手冊粵日
programme.desc: 智悟與皮皮受邀出席電視節目，說起他們初相識的往事。在一次叢林探險營中，智悟認識了皮皮與醫學生凱伊。然而在探險途中，導遊與小孩竟咳嗽發燒，甚至吐血，懷疑是未知病毒作祟，三人繼而展開穿越叢林的求生之旅。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 這回的「勇闖零食廠」由蚌蚌公主負責管理，她首先要求到來闖關的零食小兵團接受「廠長話」考驗。在淘汰賽階段，兩隊各有一位小兵正確地完成了所有指令，廠長只好以反應快慢分勝負，稍慢者可謂雖敗猶榮。執行果園收集任務時，兩隊都要團長姐姐提示要採摘甚麼水果。不過其中一隊多次觸響鈴鐺警報，被迫重新收採，延誤了完成時間。壓軸挑戰「看圖砌漢堡」，兩隊分別聽從廠長與團長的指示，努力將漢堡砌回圖中模樣，實力頗為接近。

programme.title: 忍者亂太郎粵日
programme.desc: 伊助提出去後山玩，一丁班全班都想參加，但發覺大部份人都要當值打掃。拔天坊墮入騙局而面臨破產危機。其子女找亂太郎他們商討解決辦法。根據利吉所說，拔天坊的事件，可能涉及某個城堡的陰謀。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻:最強生命線粵
programme.desc: 十字韌帶撕裂通常因運動或扭傷引致，且無法自行癒合。30歲的林先生，是健身教練，7至8年前第一次十字韌帶撕裂，接受傳統手術，將後腿筋移植至十字韌帶，最近運動時斷第二次，今次手術改用人工筋。另一位41歲的REX，是前港隊代表，2017年退役後繼續教拳擊，2019年一次教班時十字韌帶撕裂，受傷後3至4個月接受傳統手術，將後腿筋移植，透過手術再配合物理治療一段時間便康復，更於2025年復出繼續比賽並贏得比賽。

programme.title: 東張西望粵 及 富途證券特約:富途講美股粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2850粵 及 保誠精選「寵愛寶」呈獻：社畜求生101粵
programme.desc: 力蓮欲與Ceci洽談某食品的獨家代理權，卻接連被雷公搶佔先機。她向敢威提出證據，懷疑璟風吃裡扒外協助雷公，璟風縱解釋，敢威卻不信。為要取回敢威的信任，並避免尋寶圖有所損失，璟風決意要從雷公手上取得食品的代理權。璟風找力蓮洽談代理權之事，力蓮卻拒絕合作，並提到敢威授意奪得代理權之人可成為尋寶圖話事人，她揚言要奪回尋寶圖，更透露真正目的……璟風決不可讓力蓮得逞，與若水等全力爭取代理權，卻遇到阻滯……

programme.title: 森下仁丹Bifina Si 益生菌呈獻：非份之罪#12粵PG
programme.desc: 紹聰生前立了信託基金，悅萍可合法繼承大屋業權，惟條件是要待淑嫻與宏智離世後才可全權擁有。淑嫻認定是悅萍殺害紹聰，還想將罪名嫁禍，甚不服氣。帶弟亦開始認同淑嫻所想，於是聯手調查悅萍，另邊廂，警方亦開始將調查方向移往悅萍……淑嫻憑蛛絲馬跡找到悅萍住處，欲帶走宏智，怎料悅萍說出一個現況，令宏智決定留下陪伴悅萍。警方查到越來越多罪證，帶悅萍及宏智返警署協助調查，悅萍錄口供時，宏智突然心臟病發作……

programme.title: 食玩假期呈獻：江湖見粵
programme.desc: 武當山於武俠小說之中，是一個「武林聖地」。當年有明成祖朱棣登山欲拜見張三丰，這次有黎耀祥、麥包上來參觀，卻發覺與想像之中有大不同？拍攝時剛好遇着下雪，眼前雪景顯得特別豐富，只因植物種類多？小說內，各派武林人士集結於金頂，麥包卻發現被小說「騙」了，既要不斷爬梯級登上海拔一千六百米山峰，而且頂處僅有幾百呎面積！還是到皇家級建築群紫霄宮，悠然賞覧，再跟三丰派的掌門人見個面，化身張無忌耍太極，隨心寫意。

programme.title: 女法醫解密#22粵普PG
programme.desc: 秦莞找李牧雲理論，懷疑其為天道社成員。燕澤囚禁燕涵，燕離闖入後被刺傷；燕涵殺死燕澤後毒發身亡，臨終悔罪。另一方面，皇后與素貴妃發生衝突並同歸於盡。太后自責，決定傳位燕綏，請燕遲輔佐，並頒佈一連串新法…

獵鷹#20粵PG
programme.desc: （大結局）戚幹中槍入院，大偉不顧劉Sir阻止，到醫院探病，但見父親昏迷不醒，不禁悽然。劉Sir使計挑撥陳水與一帆，令陳水出庭指證一帆；又用心理壓力使傑與警方合作，指證崔福。一帆窮途末路，詐病入院藉機逃走，但久候船未見，與張錦一起藏身郊區，但卒被劉Sir之「射鷹」行動拘捕。戚幹奮勇救子，令同袍欽佩，大偉亦因努力於職務同獲上級讚賞，被賜予獎狀，大偉深感父親捨身救己，遂將奬狀轉贈父親，以表心意。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#140粵
programme.desc: 大廈出現「偷鞋怪賊」，將放在門外所有鞋偷去。眾人發現慶家中的按摩椅被搬到朋家後，欲搶先享受，麗想出以做些有利高家事情的人才可用按摩椅，而義、情及溢亦樂意參加。義及溢努力做家務，令情失去享用的機會。

programme.title: 命轉皇后#15粵普PG
programme.desc: 雪寧憑觀察推斷出謝危乃假身分，謝危不置可否。薛定非奉平南王之命攜燕牧的下半封信入京，豈料信被公儀丞部下偷走。雪寧故意把燕臨送的琴變賣以便籌錢讓周寅之跟逆黨換信，以此引起謝危注意，並借謝危之手杜絕後患。

programme.title: 我係小廚神3粵
programme.desc: Cindy與Cyrus隨麥美恩及肥仔到台中，參觀農地及種菇基地，鴨子亦可擔任農夫？即摘即食花刺身，Cyrus卻有所堅持！考驗來了，他們要以阿薩姆紅茶製出創意紅茶蛋糕，大家還看到Cyrus與Cindy待人接物的大不同。在港的小廚神學包蝦餃及造型鳳梨酥，袁文傑只看不吃，選出最佳視藝作品。徐菁遙指導各人炮製梳乎厘，小廚神們加點創意，做出七彩繽紛的甜品，有人竟以亂七八糟為題做甜品，不怕被批評嗎？

programme.title: 我親愛的朋友們
programme.desc: 【老人也有春天！七十歲的我們 終於學會說不】她們是一群走過風雨的老人，曾為家庭默默奉獻，如今選擇為自己綻放。一場聚會重新牽起年少情誼，也掀開多年壓抑的心事。有人鼓起勇氣離婚，搬進夢想中的小屋；有人在意外後學會面對過錯，重拾友情的信任；有人對抗失智，卻仍記得朋友的名字與笑聲。女兒朴莞在傾聽中理解母親，在書寫中記錄她們的光芒。人生未晚，她們手牽著手，用皺紋寫下溫柔，也用笑聲走向嶄新的旅程。

programme.title: 好搭檔
programme.desc: 【張娜拉火力全開！槓上小三、手撕出軌老公超過癮】王牌律師遇上菜鳥新人，一場法庭與情感的雙重對決即將展開！《好搭檔》講述擁有17年經驗的離婚律師車恩京，在面對丈夫背叛後，與熱血正義的新人韓宥利成為「最不可能搭檔」的辦公室火花組合。冷面魔頭與理想主義者，兩人從互看不順眼，到聯手應對一樁樁離婚官司，解開婚姻背後的人性兩難。冷靜與熱血交織，掀起一場場心碎又痛快的離婚風暴！

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 我親愛的朋友們
programme.desc: 【老人也有春天！七十歲的我們 終於學會說不】她們是一群走過風雨的老人，曾為家庭默默奉獻，如今選擇為自己綻放。一場聚會重新牽起年少情誼，也掀開多年壓抑的心事。有人鼓起勇氣離婚，搬進夢想中的小屋；有人在意外後學會面對過錯，重拾友情的信任；有人對抗失智，卻仍記得朋友的名字與笑聲。女兒朴莞在傾聽中理解母親，在書寫中記錄她們的光芒。人生未晚，她們手牽著手，用皺紋寫下溫柔，也用笑聲走向嶄新的旅程。

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘

programme.title: 壞記憶橡皮擦
programme.desc: 【金在中攜陳世娫出演新劇《壞記憶橡皮擦》回歸電視劇！！】曾是被看好的網球之星李君，在負傷之後喪失了自尊心，認為自己從人生的主角變成配角。遇上腦研究中心的醫生景珠妍，使用了記憶橡皮擦抹去了過去記憶，重生為運動經紀人，而景珠妍也意外成了他的初戀。因被篡改的記憶開始的羅曼史，在得知真相后其結局將會如何呢？

programme.title: 女神降臨
programme.desc: 【人氣漫畫改編，車銀優搭文佳煐神還原廣受好評！！】國中時因長相不起眼飽受霸凌的任朱靜，掌握化妝技巧後上妝搖身一變成為校園女神。與隱藏著不為人知傷痛的校園男神李修豪及個性直率講義氣的韓書俊，三角戀情一觸即發的一起面對著戀愛、生活帶來的的青春浪漫喜劇。

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.title: 戀人的謊言
programme.desc: 舒菲和林菲從小一起長大，姐妹情深，形影不離，在大學期間英年才俊奇然學長喜歡林菲，但林菲對奇然沒有感覺，暗戀奇然的舒菲借用林菲的名字和奇然書信來往，姐妹兩同時進入購物電視台上班，意外發現自己的上司居然是奇然，奇然依然鍾情林菲，舒菲暗戀心情破碎，心思放工作上，偶然結識導演藍天，兩人互生情愫，而林菲職場失意，又得知舒菲當年利用她的名字和奇然書信來往，於是陷害舒菲泄露商業機密，害公司倒閉，舒菲陷入輿論壓力中，藍天陪在舒菲身邊，拆穿林菲的謊言，最後林菲真心悔過，和舒菲和好如初，舒菲也收穫和愛情和事業。

programme.title: 我親愛的朋友們
programme.desc: 【老人也有春天！七十歲的我們 終於學會說不】她們是一群走過風雨的老人，曾為家庭默默奉獻，如今選擇為自己綻放。一場聚會重新牽起年少情誼，也掀開多年壓抑的心事。有人鼓起勇氣離婚，搬進夢想中的小屋；有人在意外後學會面對過錯，重拾友情的信任；有人對抗失智，卻仍記得朋友的名字與笑聲。女兒朴莞在傾聽中理解母親，在書寫中記錄她們的光芒。人生未晚，她們手牽著手，用皺紋寫下溫柔，也用笑聲走向嶄新的旅程。

programme.title: 好搭檔
programme.desc: 【張娜拉火力全開！槓上小三、手撕出軌老公超過癮】王牌律師遇上菜鳥新人，一場法庭與情感的雙重對決即將展開！《好搭檔》講述擁有17年經驗的離婚律師車恩京，在面對丈夫背叛後，與熱血正義的新人韓宥利成為「最不可能搭檔」的辦公室火花組合。冷面魔頭與理想主義者，兩人從互看不順眼，到聯手應對一樁樁離婚官司，解開婚姻背後的人性兩難。冷靜與熱血交織，掀起一場場心碎又痛快的離婚風暴！

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 壞記憶橡皮擦
programme.desc: 【金在中攜陳世娫出演新劇《壞記憶橡皮擦》回歸電視劇！！】曾是被看好的網球之星李君，在負傷之後喪失了自尊心，認為自己從人生的主角變成配角。遇上腦研究中心的醫生景珠妍，使用了記憶橡皮擦抹去了過去記憶，重生為運動經紀人，而景珠妍也意外成了他的初戀。因被篡改的記憶開始的羅曼史，在得知真相后其結局將會如何呢？

programme.title: 女神降臨
programme.desc: 【人氣漫畫改編，車銀優搭文佳煐神還原廣受好評！！】國中時因長相不起眼飽受霸凌的任朱靜，掌握化妝技巧後上妝搖身一變成為校園女神。與隱藏著不為人知傷痛的校園男神李修豪及個性直率講義氣的韓書俊，三角戀情一觸即發的一起面對著戀愛、生活帶來的的青春浪漫喜劇。

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.title: 壞記憶橡皮擦
programme.desc: 【金在中攜陳世娫出演新劇《壞記憶橡皮擦》回歸電視劇！！】曾是被看好的網球之星李君，在負傷之後喪失了自尊心，認為自己從人生的主角變成配角。遇上腦研究中心的醫生景珠妍，使用了記憶橡皮擦抹去了過去記憶，重生為運動經紀人，而景珠妍也意外成了他的初戀。因被篡改的記憶開始的羅曼史，在得知真相后其結局將會如何呢？

programme.title: 戀人的謊言
programme.desc: 舒菲和林菲從小一起長大，姐妹情深，形影不離，在大學期間英年才俊奇然學長喜歡林菲，但林菲對奇然沒有感覺，暗戀奇然的舒菲借用林菲的名字和奇然書信來往，姐妹兩同時進入購物電視台上班，意外發現自己的上司居然是奇然，奇然依然鍾情林菲，舒菲暗戀心情破碎，心思放工作上，偶然結識導演藍天，兩人互生情愫，而林菲職場失意，又得知舒菲當年利用她的名字和奇然書信來往，於是陷害舒菲泄露商業機密，害公司倒閉，舒菲陷入輿論壓力中，藍天陪在舒菲身邊，拆穿林菲的謊言，最後林菲真心悔過，和舒菲和好如初，舒菲也收穫和愛情和事業。

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - Submarino
programme.desc: Accidentalmente, Chip y sus amigos caen a un lago donde son recogidos por la nave espacial de un átomo de sodio, que los lleva a Sodia, una ciudad submarina. Allí, los átomos de sodio y cloro viven un largo conflicto. El cloro quiere unirse al sodio para formar moléculas de cloruro de sodio, mientras que los átomos de sodio prefieren permanecer juntos. La patrulla de antimateria entra en contacto con el cloro y les propone proporcionarles rifles para dominar al sodio y así obligarlos a molecularizarse, pero Chip se burla de la antimateria y logra que el cloro y el sodio dejen de ser enemigos, restableciendo la paz en el mundo submarino.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La tormenta
programme.desc: Dentro de un viejo molino de viento, en medio de una fuerte tormenta, Chip y sus amigos esperan que pase y continúan su camino. Afuera, bajo el viento tempestuoso, la patrulla de antimateria le comunica al Dr. No que ya han encontrado al niño. El malvado científico confía en que esta vez no fallarán. Pero cuando el viento amaina, Chip idea una estrategia y deja a la antimateria encerrada en el molino, mientras él y los átomos siguen adelante.

programme.title: Until Tomorrow
programme.desc: A single mother's courage is tested when she resorts to desperate measures to hide her illegitimate child from her parents.

programme.title: Rival
programme.desc: 9-year-old Roman follows his mother Oksana, an illegal nurse in Germany. Oksana falls in love with 62-year-old Gert who tries to befriend Roman. While spending an afternoon alone with Roman, Gert suddenly dies of a heart attack, leaving Roman alone.

programme.title: Pari
programme.desc: Pari, an Iranian mother, goes to Athens with her husband to meet their son studying abroad. When their son is nowhere to be seen, she embarks on a journey in the unfamiliar city where she will uncover more than just her son’s whereabouts.

programme.title: Train Driver's Diary
programme.desc: As Ilija nears retirement, his record of unintentional deaths as a train driver weighs heavy. His adopted son, Sima, fears following in his footsteps. But as days pass without incident, Ilija's determination to ensure Sima's success takes a dark turn.

programme.title: The Traveller: The Valley of Fear
programme.desc: In the Basque Country, Captain Yann Kandinsky investigates the disappearance of a young bookseller whose case mirrors a murder from twenty years earlier. All evidence points to the same man—Yves Cesnoz, convicted of the first crime—but Kandinsky believes the real killer is still at large.

programme.title: Hunters On A White Field
programme.desc: Deep in the Swedish woods, three friends go on an extended weekend hunting trip. After an initial spell of success, the animals suddenly vanish without a trace. Despite being in a forest without animals, the men decide that the hunt must continue.

programme.title: Our Children
programme.desc: A doctor brings a boy to Belgium and raises him as his own. When the boy reaches manhood, he gets married and starts his own family, but he still relies on the doctor, his adoptive father. When trouble strikes his family, dependence turns into domination.

programme.title: Mountain Woman
programme.desc: When famine overruns a small Japanese village, Rin must leave the village in order to protect her father accused of theft. Rin heads deep into Mt. Hayachin, and crosses the forbidden mountain god's shrine, where the goddess of thieves is said to dwell.

programme.title: The Apple of My Eye
programme.desc: Elise is beautiful, funny, and blind. Theo is a seducer but a loser. They love music. But when they meet in the elevator, it's hate at first sight.

programme.title: MAIA: A Solarpunk Story
programme.desc: Alfea lives as a scientist in the comforts of Maia, the last standing city on Earth. One day she found Aruna, an outsider seeking help for her endangered village. Together, they uncover the secrets behind the city of Maia.

programme.title: Secret Delivery
programme.desc: Based on true events. In WWII's snowy Giant Mountains, a group of children help a French pilot escape by moving him between villages. They face enemy soldiers, traitors, and harsh winter while demonstrating courage and friendship.

programme.title: In His Hands
programme.desc: Clara, a lawyer, leads a serene but monotonous life alongside her husband Damien and their two children. One evening, she succumbs to the charm of a mysterious sculptor. This one scorching night will have dramatic repercussions for her and her family.

programme.title: Until Tomorrow
programme.desc: A single mother's courage is tested when she resorts to desperate measures to hide her illegitimate child from her parents.

programme.desc: A family of nomads dwelling high in the mountains of Kyrgyzstan doesn't need any of the conveniences of modern civilization in order to be happy. But progress is creeping into their lives regardless, destroying legends and traditions as it comes.

programme.title: The Traveller: At the End of the Night
programme.desc: Laurent, the brother of Captain Kandinsky, gets into an argument with a young woman who accuses him of harassment. All suspicion inevitably falls on Laurent when she is discovered dead the next day, and it is up to Kandinsky to clear his brother’s name.

programme.title: Stormskerry Maja
programme.desc: At 17, Maja marries humble fisherman Janne and starts a family on the remote island of Stormskerry, where survival is a constant challenge. Amidst the hardships, Maja awakens to her potential, finding resilience and a love that transcends life and death.

programme.desc: A female teacher tries to hide the scratches on her car as carefully as the cracks in her heart. When her clash with a troubled student deepens, two unseen scars emerge on campus — one visible, the other quietly breaking her apart.

programme.title: Paddy and Chris: Road Tripping S01 - Switzerland
programme.desc: Paddy and Chris head to Switzerland to explore its multi-million-pound wellness industry. The lads travel to one of the country's top wellness resorts for a full body MOT to assess how well they're ageing. After a consultation with specialists, they're put through a rigorous training programme that reveals their true biological ages, surprising them both. Paddy, also eager to address his thinning hair, travels to Zurich to a men-only clinic to explore available treatments.

programme.title: Earth S01 - Green
programme.desc: Chris Packham tells the miraculous story of how plant life turned Earth from a barren rock into a vibrant green world - a four-billion year saga of extraordinary highs and lows that almost wiped out all life on the planet. Beginning as a water world without land masses, a giant asteroid bombardment triggered Earth's plate tectonics, leading to huge fungi, soil and giant swamp forests. But the early plants locked so much carbon dioxide that global temperatures suddenly plunged.

programme.title: Wild Japan S01 - Honshu
programme.desc: The central island of Honshu is home to over 100 million people, and its biggest city, Tokyo, is one of the largest urban metropolises on earth. But it has a wild heart - most of Honshu is mountainous. This wilderness is home to an astonishing range of wildlife - black bears, monkeys, exquisite fireflies and even cow demons. But all across this island, from the mountains to the edge of the sea, people and nature are drawn together in the most unexpected ways.

programme.title: Amazing Railway Adventures with Nick Knowles S02 - Morocco
programme.desc: Nick's train leaves from Tangier and it's a special one; AL Boraq, which speeds along the high-speed line making its way down the west coast. At its fastest Al Boraq reaches nearly 200 mph and is run entirely on wind power. The ambition is to run Morocco's entire railway system on green energy within the next two years.

programme.title: Earth S01 - Atmosphere

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Hospital
programme.desc: Doctor Bluey is needed when Dad gets a very curious x-ray from Nurse Bingo. It seems he has a cat in his tummy!

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Squash
programme.desc: When dad and Uncle Stripe play a game of squash, Bluey and Bingo are in control of their every move, and Bingo proves that big siblings don't always beat little siblings.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Faceytalk
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo love to video chat with Muffin and Socks so they can all draw pictures together. When Muffin won't give Socks a turn, the kids discover what happens when you hog.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Ragdoll
programme.desc: Dad agrees to take Bluey and Bingo to the shops to buy an ice-cream if they can get him into the car. Only problem is... he's just entered 'Ragdoll' mode!

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions S01 - Andy and the Blue Duck Chicks
programme.desc: In this episode Andy, Jen and Scout head to New Zealand on a baby animal mission to help rescue a family of blue ducks and their chicks from a fast flowing river. Along the way, Andy takes a ride on a pukeko chick and meets a hedgehog.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Tubes
programme.desc: Bella and Lift enjoy making funny honk noises with tubes. They visit Tincy the Spider, who uses terrific tubes to make music with the Playtimers.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Round Up Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels go on the trail of a lost herd of cattle with Duggee and his old pal Rodeo Horse, who teaches them how to be cowhands... and earn their Round Up Badges in the process!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Game Show Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels have played all of their board games, so Duggee entertains them by putting on a Game Show, with some help hosting from his good friend Ladybug.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Puddle Badge
programme.desc: Happy sets his sights on a very questionable looking puddle that he is determined to splash in, much to the horror of Duggee and the other Squirrels - and the tiny citizens of Midgetropolis who live inside it!

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Funky Fireflies, Selangor River, Malaysia
programme.desc: The Go Jetters are paddling down Malaysia's Selangor River in canoes to look at the region's fireflies. But after a bend in the river, they encounter Glitch attempting to chop down one of the protected mangrove trees, hoping to impress Tala with the rare plant. Although they manage to stop him, the approaching dark and some thick mud leave them in a tricky situation. Can the team work out how to light their way and find their friends?

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Go Jet Academy: Weather Prediction Predicament
programme.desc: Cadets all over the island tune in to watch Foz present the first Go Jet Academy weather report, which uses high-tech balloons and sea-buoys to predict the weather. But panic ensues when Glitch decides to broadcast his own, fake weather report - leaving the cadets and Grimbots stranded. Can the Go Jetters un-glitch their weather equipment and save the cadets?

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S24 - Shankar's Makeover
programme.desc: There's a fancy dress competition on the railways and while Thomas and the others are excited, Shankar doesn't want to join in.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S03 - Cinema Scoot
programme.desc: Sarah and Duck join Scooter Boy at the cinema to watch his favourite film, but the sound doesn't seem to be working.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S03 - Snowball Skate
programme.desc: Sarah and Duck explore a Winter Fair in the park, and discover an amazing skating rink inside a giant snowball!

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Dig
programme.desc: Stanley helps Fifi and Fred dig up some shiny stones in their garden that turn out to be old bits of mosaic. With the help of Cynthia and Hettie, they put the pieces back together.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Farm
programme.desc: Amare asks Stanley to help her on the farm. Stanley asks Little Woo, Fred and Fifi to join him in sowing seeds, watering plants and picking apples, all whilst having fun.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - My Dad Calls My Mum a Badger
programme.desc: Kisses, cuddles, and making renewable energy from cow poo! Parents are brilliant!

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S02 - It's Time to Visit a Maze
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran visit a maze and see their friends Alfie and Ellie. They race towards the centre of the maze, but JoJo can't seem to figure out how to get there. Instead of rushing through, she learns to take her time and enjoy the journey.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Unicorse
programme.desc: Bluey can't get to sleep, so Mum reads her one last story. But they are interrupted by Unicorse, the most annoying hand puppet in the world, whom Bluey tries to reform.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Curry Quest
programme.desc: Bingo and Dad must brave a swooping magpie protecting its nest, when they go on a curry swap to Mackenzie's house through the park.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Magic
programme.desc: Bluey teaches Bingo how to use magic so she can make Mum play with her, but she forgets to explain the most important rule: never use magic for cheekiness.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - Happy's First Day
programme.desc: Happy has always loved the water, even though it makes a mess. But while swimming around in his paddling pool at the playhouse, Duggee reminds the Squirrels that there was a time when Happy feared water.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Spot the Difference Badge
programme.desc: Duggee looks different, but what is it? By playing some looking games, the Squirrels learn how best to spot the difference.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Mystery Seeds
programme.desc: When Duggee finds some seeds it's time for some gardening!

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - Amazon Rain Forest, South America
programme.desc: Glitch wants a picnic so he stops the rain in the rainforest, upsetting the local tree frogs.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S02 - Gooseberry
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits Theatre, it's Gooseberry, singing a song about everything you have to do to become a Gooseberry Club member.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S02 - Festive Special
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits Theatre, Carrot, Potato, Parsnip and Brussels Sprout perform the festive classic Auld Lang Syne - if Potato lands from the moon on time.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Wishing Tree
programme.desc: Evil Pea blows all the lanterns away during the Lantern Festival. Supertato struggles to get them all back and needs Broccoli's help to save the day.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Grape Kids' Super Camp
programme.desc: Supertato shows the Grape Kids how to camp Supertato-style, but Evil Pea arrives and wows them with her ice camping. Before long, the Grape Kids need to be rescued by Supertato.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Listen
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-­Laa and Po take it in turns to listen to music through a pair of headphones. The Teletubbies love dancing to the music they hear.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S07 - B
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'b', and we go on an adventure around the sound. We see some brilliant beards, blow some bubbles and meet a baboon bouncing balls!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S01 - Messy-power
programme.desc: Hey, who turned out the lights? Messy goes to Okido and finds out electricity can lead to music, lights and disco dancing!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Turbo Ted
programme.desc: Ted the bus wants to be faster, and Mojo swops every top to try to make it happen. But it's Bo's homemade rocket that gives Ted the boost he needs... all the way into space!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Housework
programme.desc: Mum and Dad vow to only finish their boring housework when the kids stop acting silly, but that's never going to happen, so they end up trying the same approach themselves.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Sheep Dog
programme.desc: Dad agrees to play Sheepdog with Bluey and Bingo to stop them from disturbing Mum who is taking a well-earned rest, but looking after a sheep is harder work than they expected.

programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-­Laa and Po take it in turns to listen to music through a pair of headphones. The Teletubbies love dancing to the music they hear.

programme.title: Black Magic
programme.desc: Hsu Lo is up against an evil black magic practitioner San Kan Mi, who wants to place a death spell on him and a love spell on his fiancee Wang Chu Ying. Fortunately, Wang's friends manage to find another veteran witch doctor to take on the evil San. This bone-chilling tale of good versus evil races to a heart-stopping ending.

programme.title: One Way Only
programme.desc: Danny is a motorbike workshop owner, once was a renowned motorcycle racer, but were seriously injured in an illegal race. Mai, student of Danny, wins a race in Macau under Danny's help. However, because of money and honour, Mai joins illegal races. After knowing this, Li persuades Mai to stop illegal races, but Mai seems cannot find his way out...

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his people's livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter.

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again
programme.desc: The Mad Monk is up against the equally legendary scholar-turned-genie, Lu Tung Pin. The duo create havoc as they vie with each other, be it in mirth, magic, women or weapons!

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: At St. Morant Hospital, a harried but lovely administrator must deal with lusty interns, student nurses, a delirious surgeon, a dissection fiend, a criticizing Commissioner and gross negligence at regular intervals! This comedy is based on the hugely successful British Carry On! film series.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: The Bloody Escape
programme.desc: Ku is a skilled Kung Fu artist brought up by the bandits and does not agree with the brutal leader of the bandit's camp. He rescues Tong, a young lady forced to become the leader's wife, causing both the authorities and bandits to come after them. Ku has to stand up against the bandits that he grew up with so as to start a new life for himself.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Mission Impossible
programme.desc: A sword master's daughter is pursued and poisoned by an evil master when bringing back the stolen Golden Sword to the palace. She dies on the run and returns as a spirit to take revenge by killing the evil master, and soon vanishes after returning the sword to the emperor.

programme.title: Crocodile River
programme.desc: This story has a Romeo and Juliet flavour. Two families who hate each other live across the opposite sides of a river filled with crocodiles and do not bother to have a bridge built. Their respective children meet in university and fall in love, but have to find ways to be together and resolve the hatred between their families.

programme.title: What Price Honesty
programme.desc: In this period martial arts thriller, three police graduates are assigned to a town rife with crimes and corruption. They vow to uphold justice but are hampered by their corrupt superior, resulting in them putting their lives and the lives of their beloved in danger.

programme.title: The Duel of the Century
programme.desc: A duel has been arranged at the Forbidden City between two formidable swordsmen of the martial world, Ye Gu Cheng and Xi Men Chui Xue. Lu Xiao Feng smells something fishy about the duel as the two swordsmen never met and do not have any conflicts. He decides to investigate more with Hua Man Lou, and eventually uncovers some hidden conspiracies...

programme.title: The 36th Chamber of Shaolin
programme.desc: Gordon Liu plays an anti-Manchu rebel who escapes to the Shaolin Temple and learns what it truly takes to become a martial arts master by challenging the 35 Shaolin Kung Fu chambers, eventually creating the 36th chamber himself.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: Marco Polo
programme.desc: Mongolian emperor Kublai Khan is being assassinated while meeting with the Italian explorer Marco Polo. Marco Polo is appointed to lead the troops for the emperor to wipe out the anti-Mongol rebels. Yet, he is touched by these rebels who are resisting the Mongolian invasion of their homeland. Will Marco Polo stay loyal to the emperor?

programme.title: Marco Polo
programme.desc: Mongolian emperor Kublai Khan is being assassinated while meeting with the Italian explorer Marco Polo. Marco Polo is appointed to lead the troops for the emperor to wipe out the anti-Mongol rebels. Yet, he is touched by these rebels who are resisting the Mongolian invasion of their homeland. Will Marco Polo stay loyal to the emperor?

programme.title: Love With The Perfect Stranger
programme.desc: After breaking up with his girlfriend, salesman Bao meets a rich girl, Jin Jin, who just broke up with her boyfriend. Two equally heartbroken strangers fall in love instantly and get married on impulse. The couple lives happily together until Jin Jin finds herself pregnant with her ex-boyfriend's baby...

programme.title: The Devil's Mirror
programme.desc: A power-hungry Witch who leads the Bloody Ghouls Clan, seeks two magical mirrors, Wind Mirror and Thunder Mirror, which are owned by Bai and the Wen Clan respectively. She needs both mirrors to find the location of a powerful weapon that will make her invincible and will stop at nothing to get her hands on them.

programme.title: Danger has Two Faces
programme.desc: Many years ago, Inspector Kam killed an innocent man and decided to resign from the police force. He became a professional killer who disguises as a pet store owner. When his best friend, Bobby begins investigating recent murder cases committed by Kam, he discovers that the mastermind behind these cases is actually his superintendent.

programme.title: The Swordmates
programme.desc: Li asks his swordmate Wang to protect his family while he is away, but Wang rapes his wife and even has his convoy attacked. Li escaped but fears his daughter is still in danger, so he asks the nephew of his master to help protect her...

programme.title: The Lotus Lamp
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai plays both mother and son in this lavish fable about a goddess who falls in love with a mortal scholar (Cheng Pei-pei in her debut role). Over two years in production, it was released on the first anniversary of Linda's tragic suicide.

programme.title: Chinatown Kid
programme.desc: After getting into trouble with a local gangster, Chui Ho, in Hong Kong, Tam Dong flees to San Francisco and manages to get a job in a restaurant in Chinatown. Tam Dong finds himself embroiled with the gangsters again in San Francisco, and has to fight Chui Ho when the two meet again...

programme.title: Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls' high school, is stuck with a baby that isn't his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

programme.title: The Shadow Whip
programme.desc: Three hundred thousand worth of silver is robbed by a thief using a whip as the weapon. As it is a signature weapon used by a martial arts master "Shadow Whip", he is suspected and hunted. No one sees him after that. Fifteen years later, a young girl Yang shows up using the same weapon. Who is this girl and what has happened to "Shadow Whip"?

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: A sweet inn-keeper's daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle.

programme.title: The Iron Buddha
programme.desc: After a notorious rapist Xiao kills his master and the entire clan, Han the last surviving disciple, decides to take revenge. He must find the legendary Hulong Blade to counter Xiao's Evil Poisonous Sword, but as Han has never seen Xiao before, he is deceived when Xiao poses as an ally to try and steal his Blade in the process.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: A talented scholar, Bo Hu, is attracted by the pretty maid, Qiu Xiang. In order to get close to her and win her love, he disguises as a servant to work in the same household. Qiu Xiang does not believe Bo Hu when he discloses his true identity to her, only falling in love with him when he reveals his talents and with his friends' help.

programme.title: King Eagle
programme.desc: A young swordman, King Eagle, unwillingly gets involved in the internal affairs of a powerful clan and becomes their target. He is saved by the female chief of the clan, Lin, and falls in love with her. However, Lin's sister is part of all evil plots and betrays her. Even so, Lin begs King Eagle not to harm her sister.

programme.title: The Kingdom and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved...

programme.title: The Five Venoms
programme.desc: A dying master dispatches his last pupil to track down five ex-students who are each an expert in his own lethal combat style. He fears they will steal the fortune belonging to their clan and tasks his pupil to prevent their attempt.

programme.title: The Five Venoms
programme.desc: A dying master dispatches his last pupil to track down five ex-students who are each an expert in his own lethal combat style. He fears they will steal the fortune belonging to their clan and tasks his pupil to prevent their attempt.

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: The Tea House
programme.desc: Big Brother Cheng fled from the mainland to Hong Kong, where he opened a teahouse in a housing estate, hoping to find a peaceful life. However, relentless provocations from local triad gangs go unaddressed by the police, prompting Cheng and his friends at the teahouse to seek revenge.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: After beating several famous swordsmen, Chin Wu Hsin of the Mo Shan clan challenges Supreme Swordsman to a duel, hoping to win his title, and is beaten and humiliated. The winner taunts him to find a Supreme Sword made by Old Eagle, a famous sword-maker. When his offer to buy a sword from Old Eagle, is turned down, he challenges Old Eagle to a duel, and snatches his sword in a foul play. Old Eagle's own son Shih Yen-peh vows to avenge for his father...

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: Adapted from a chapter of the classic Chinese legend "Investiture of the Gods", this is the story of Na Cha set 3000 years ago. After Na Cha sacrificed his life to save his parents, he is reincarnated with his spirit embodied in a lotus flower and is armed with two magic weapons to save the people from their despotic emperor.

programme.title: The Convict Killer
programme.desc: After spending fifteen years in prison on trumped-up charges for drug smuggling, the martial arts master Teng Piao embarks on a journey to take revenge on the person who sets him up - "Black Leopard". Unfortunately for Piao, no one knows the real identity of "Black Leopard", except that there is a black leopard tattoo on his chest.

programme.title: River of Tears
programme.desc: Retired singer Fang lives happily with her husband and son. Tragedy happens when a man from her past returns to haunt her. In an ensuing struggle to free her from his clutches, her husband dies in a car accident. Blamed by her father-in-law for her husband's death, Fang gets chased out of the house and goes back to singing to make a living...

programme.title: Tales of a Eunuch
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao enters the palace and unexpectedly befriends Emperor Kang Xi. At the same time, he is assigned by a revolutionary group to steal the valuable "Sutra of 42 Chapters," which Emperor Kang Xi himself is also seeking. Demonstrating keen intelligence, Xiao Bao deftly navigates between opposing factions and successfully evades danger.

programme.title: The Singing Escort
programme.desc: Betty Ting plays Susan, a young woman hiding from her father by being a nightclub singer in Japan. Pop singer Chao Ke-jen (Lin Chong) gets permission from his boss to visit Japan, with the condition that he finds the boss's daughter. Boy finds girl, boy falls in love. But will the father approve?

programme.title: The Chinese Boxer
programme.desc: A Japanese karate master and Diao Er, who has been expelled from his martial arts school, return to the school to kill the school master and his disciples. After the massacre, disciple Lei Ming embarks on a vigorous training regime and vows to avenge their deaths. A fatal battle is about to begin...

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: In Huangmei Opera tradition, this movie tells the love story of Wen, who sells himself as a slave to a rich family, and Huo, the family's young daughter. The lovers are kept apart by Huo's stepmother and Huo escapes by dressing up as a man. Wen is framed and put into jail so Huo has to go back and rescue her lover!

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: Set in the Tang Dynasty, the 13 adopted sons of Sha Tuo King are all renowned as royal warriors. David Chiang plays the 13th Prince, a powerful fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealously, leading to a gruesome family feud.

programme.title: The Warlord
programme.desc: A bandit became a warlord in northern China by helping Russia fight against Japan. Due to his ignorance and silly behaviour, he is seen as a joke to everyone. The warlord is finally killed by the daughter of a troupe master whom he had killed for no reason, bringing a befitting end to a traitor.

programme.title: Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: A Wu Dang disciple Fu, kills the chief of Wu Dang Clan and frames it on the chief's illegitimate child, Yun. Fu then proclaims himself the new chief and orders the killing of Yun, who vows to avenge his father's death and learns the invincible silkworm martial arts style in order to defeat Fu.

programme.desc: When a young housewife’s debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle…

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A master gambler and his partner are recruited to investigate a Shanghai tycoon suspected of using his casino as a front for espionage. As they enter the high-stakes gambling world, they must outwit a dangerous opponent in a deadly game of skill and deception.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to “Casino Tycoon”. 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down…

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey1-Pandora's box
programme.desc: Joker, a carefree bandit leader, learns he is the reincarnation of the Monkey King. As demons and immortals close in, he is drawn into a chaotic, time-bending journey with the mystical Pandora’s Box. Caught between past and present, he must choose between destiny and freedom.

programme.title: Gorgeous
programme.desc: A romantic message in a bottle sends Taiwanese girl Ah Bu on a quest to Hong Kong to find its author, Albert. Disheartened when he turns out to be nothing like she imagined, she prepares to return home. However, her plans take an unexpected turn when she encounters Chan, a wealthy tycoon, and an unlikely romance begins to bloom.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognise.

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong’s Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Look for a Star
programme.desc: Sam is a charismatic tycoon who has been divorced three times. When he meets Milan, a cabaret dancer and croupier, they immediately fall in love. However, their romance faces challenges when he proposes a prenuptial agreement, putting their budding relationship at risk.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man’s matchless fighting skills are revered all over China. Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: Ip Man

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then…

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair…

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him…

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: The legendary swordsman Li, entrusts the Green Destiny sword to a noble house for safekeeping. It is swiftly stolen by Yu, a young aristocrat of immense martial skills trained by an unscrupulous outlaw master. Recognising her talent, Li tries to guide her towards righteousness but ultimately leads them both to a tragic fate.

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yip’s boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victim’s sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist’s drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A reactivated backup Chinese agent, posing as a butcher, is unexpectedly assigned to recover a stolen dinosaur skull. Sent to Hong Kong, he is aided by a female agent who is secretly working for the villains. Together, they navigate betrayals and confront the mastermind, ultimately recovering the national treasure and exposing the conspiracy.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian and seek evidence against his gang. After their release, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, as Shan cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the team’s downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by the acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar Wai, this epic action feature begins in Foshan when Ip Man, the martial arts master from the south, takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian’s daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond…

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the director's previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killer's claims of an evil spell, then it doesn't let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.
